## trait_egg_laying_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_egg_laying_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该物种的幼体发育不在母体中，而是在卵壳的保护之中进行。这一特质使其人口可以在物质充裕的时期快速增长。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:33`

### English

The young of this species do not develop inside a parent, but inside the protective shell of an egg. This allows for rapid growth during times of plenty.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:36`

## trait_egg_laying_effect

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_egg_laying_effect&lang=en)

### 中文

人口增长速度：当居住在拥有本地$r_food$（或等价物）§G产出盈余§!的行星上时§G+15%§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:34`

### English

Pop Growth Speed: §G+15%§! while living on a planet with a local $r_food$ (or equivalent) §GProduction Surplus§!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:37`

### English

## trait_seasonal_dormancy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_seasonal_dormancy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该物种在一颗存在周期性季节且可以支持冬眠的行星上演化。在现代，可以通过人工模拟这种季节性节律来有效地储存生产力较低的社会成员。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:37`

### English

This species has evolved on a planet with cyclical seasons that support hibernation. In the modern age, these seasonal triggers can be artificially simulated to efficiently store less productive members of society.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:41`

## trait_seasonal_dormancy_effect

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_seasonal_dormancy_effect&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:38`

### English

Employed Pop Upkeep: §G-15%§!\n    - Unemployed and ['concept_denizen'] Pop Upkeep: §G-75%§!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:42`

## trait_hollow_bones_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_hollow_bones_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该物种脆弱的骨骼使其移动轻盈。然而，他们更容易受到星球重力效应的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:41`

### English

The fragile bones of this species allow them to move elegantly and with ease. However, they are also more susceptible to the gravitational effects of their world.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:46`

### 中文

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_acidic_vascularity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该物种的内液是最强有力的防御。这些高腐蚀性且致命的液体一定会让任何敌人后悔刺破它的身躯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:49`

## trait_shelled_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_shelled_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些物种会把居室带在身上，这些居室可能是天然长出的、偶然发现的或是设计而来的。这些外壳提供了一个安全的庇护所，使其在夜间一定有安寝之地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:53`

### English

Whether naturally grown or found by chance (or design), this species carries their homes with them. These shells provide a protective sanctuary, ensuring there is always a place to rest for the night.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:61`

## trait_camouflage_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_camouflage_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种物种是伪装大师，能与周围环境完美融合，几乎使其自身对捕食者和猎物都不可见。它们对光学的先天理解使其在游击战中占据优势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:56`

### English

## trait_genetic_memory_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_genetic_memory_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将知识和经验传承给下一代，是许多文明的开端。而这个物种更进一步，将生存的智慧直接编码到它们的基因中，确保每一代都天生具备祖先积累的智慧。

### English

Passing down knowledge and learnings from one generation to the next has been the start of many civilizations. This species has taken it a step further by encoding survival insights directly into their genetic code, ensuring that each generation is born with the accumulated wisdom of their ancestors.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:87`

§R警告：禁用除['concept_mutation_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。§!\n\n该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。

### English

§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].§!\n\nThis species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:122`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_REGULAR&lang=en)

### 中文

$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$我们一直清楚，是猎物的血肉塑造了我们自己——每次狩猎、杀戮都让我们更上一层楼。\n\n我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。\n\n对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，在[GetStartingDrive]带来的黎明中，我们已经做好准备潜入星系这片狩猎场，收获其中所有的一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:103`

### English

$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.\n\nOur violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.\n\nThe hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the dawn of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:126`

## START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_HIVE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_HIVE&lang=en)

### 中文

$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$我们的集体潜意识一直知道自己的基因潜能——我们可以吸收并适应猎物的特性，将它们的优势整合到我们的集体中。\n\n这种古老的捕食本能延续至今达到了一种受控平衡。我们不再需要依赖狩猎来进化，而是可以在实验室内合成任何遗传物质并将其无缝地分发到整个蜂巢中。\n\n随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已经做好了准备踏遍星系，收获其中的一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:104`

### English

$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$Our shared intelligence implicitly has always understood the potential of our genetics - we can absorb and adapt the essence of our quarry, integrating their strengths into our collective.\n\nThat ancient predatory instinct still lingers, but now it is balanced and controlled. No longer must we hunt to evolve; our labs can synthesize any genetic material and seamlessly distribute it throughout our hive.\n\nWith the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to spread across the galaxy and savor all it has to offer.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:127`

## START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_DEVOURING_SWARM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_DEVOURING_SWARM&lang=en)

### 中文

$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$直到吞噬了[GetHomeWorldName]上的一切生命形式后我们才意识到了自己的愚蠢。这下我们得上哪儿去找到新的适应力？于是我们抬起了头。\n\n一般的猎食者为了生存狩猎，而我们作为完美的猎食者，狩猎是为了达到我们自身的完美。\n\n随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们又一次做好了屏息凝神的准备。星系无边无垠，宛如一场饕餮盛宴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:105`

### English

$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$Only after we had consumed every last lifeform on [GetHomeWorldName] did we realize our folly. How would we get new adaptations now? So we looked up.\n\nWe are the ultimate predators. Others hunt to survive; we hunt to perfect ourselves.\n\nWith the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to prowl once more. The galaxy is vast, and full of food.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:128`

## START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

[GetSpeciesNamePlural]生来便是猎手。浩瀚虚空也不过是我们追猎过的最深邃的荒野——而方舟就是我们生长出的最锋利的獠牙。在饥饿的驱使下，没有我们无法穿透的黑暗，也没有遥不可及的距离。\n\n我们深知，猎物的血肉塑造了我们——每次狩猎、杀戮，都让我们更上一层楼。\n\n我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。\n\n对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，随着[GetStartingDrive]的部署，我们已准备巡视星海，收获其中所有的一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:106`

### English

The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. The void is simply the deepest wilderness we have ever stalked - and our arkship, the sharpest fang we have ever grown. No darkness too complete, no distance too great, when hunger drives us forward.\n\nWe have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.\n\nOur violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.\n\nThe hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the fleet-wide installation of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:129`

## concept_adaptive_evolution_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aconcept_adaptive_evolution_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

吞噬其他生命形式的基因将推动局势的进展。\n§G完成时：§!\n$t$—基于最近吞噬的物种选择一个新的物种特质\n§Y推进方式：§!\n$t$—殖民新星球\n$t$—净化其他物种或将其作为牲口驯养\n$t$—在帝国内以奴隶或以上标准保有其他物种\n$t$—在内阁中雇佣外星领袖\n$t$—保有生物舰船\n$t$—作为巨型企业签订商业协议\n$t$—通过各种事件遭遇外星生命

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:117`

### English

The situation progresses as DNA of other lifeforms is consumed.\n§GOn Complete:§!\n$t$- Choose a new species trait based on the species recently consumed\n§YProgressed by:§!\n$t$- Colonizing new planets\n$t$- Purging or keeping other species as livestock\n$t$- Keeping other species within your Empire as slaves or at a higher standard\n$t$- Employing alien leaders on your Council\n$t$- Keeping Biological Vassals\n$t$- Forming Commercial Pacts as a MegaCorp\n$t$- Encountering alien life through events

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:142`

## trait_ruler_apex_predator_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_ruler_apex_predator_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个由“进化掠夺”定义的民族，只会允许其适应性最强的人领导他们。这位巅峰统治者不仅掠夺失败者的基因组，还夺取他们的智慧和决心，将每一次胜利都转化为走向完美统治的阶梯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:151`

### English

A people defined by Evolutionary Predation would allow none but their most adaptable to lead them. This apex ruler not only harvests the genomes of defeated foes, but also appropriates their cunning and resolve, turning every victory into a step toward perfect mastery.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:181`

## evolutionary_predators_situation_desc

### 中文

随着不断与新物种遭遇，我们对各种独特的['concept_evopred_genetic_insights']进行分析、传播。一旦完成，我们就可以演化，向我们的基因编码中永久性地增添新的正面§Y物种特质§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:171`

### English

Unique ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] are analyzed and disseminated as we encounter new species. Once finished, we will evolve, permanently adding a new positive §YSpecies Trait§! to our own genetic code.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:209`

Agreeement\n$t$- For Megacorps, maintaining Commercial Pacts\n$t$- Encountering alien life through events

## bio.1005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们物种演化得愈发复杂。在群星之间寻得新的基因物质之后，我们已经准备好吸纳其中的一个部分。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们的辛勤劳动给我们带来了一些的选择。\n\n无论做任何决定都将会影响到[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的子子孙孙们的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:252`

### English

Our species grows more complex. After scouring the stars for new genetic material, we are ready to adopt a new aspect. Thanks to the hard work of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] we have a choice.\n\nWhatever decision we make will affect the future of the [Owner.GetSpeciesName] for generations to come.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:295`

### 中文

潜伏

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:305`

### English

Stalking

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:352`

## bio.1050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工正在[Target.GetSpeciesName]定居点潜行，很快将能进入他们的建筑。我们需要耐心，而我们有的是耐心——最好的猎手总是从容不迫的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:306`

### English

Our operatives are prowling [Target.GetSpeciesName] settlements and will soon gain access to their structures. All in good time. We are a patient breed; the best hunts are never rushed.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:353`

## bio.1055.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1055.name&lang=en)

### 中文

折中

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:307`

### English

Poised

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:355`

## bio.1055.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1055.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

猎物就在眼前。我们派遣去渗透[Target.GetName]的猎手非常有信心。他们将很快能进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]的居住区，宝贵的基因物质触手可及。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:308`

### English

Our prey is in sight. The hunters we sent to infiltrate the [Target.GetName] are confident. They will soon have access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory, and all of the precious DNA within.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:356`

## bio.1060.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1060.name&lang=en)

### 中文

突袭

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:309`

### English

Pounce

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:358`

## bio.1060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工已经准备就绪。他们已经获得了进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]集居地的权限，并且准备好了合适的伪装。当然，像任何优秀的猎手一样，他们已经确保了多条撤离路线，有些比较体面，有些则不太体面。如果不得不使用下水道逃生，那可就太不幸了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:310`

### English

Our agents are ready. They have gained access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory as well as proper disguises. Naturally, like any good hunter, they have secured multiple escape routes, some more agreeable than others. It will be unfortunate should we need to make use of the sewers.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:359`

## bio.1065.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1065.name&lang=en)

### 中文

盗得基因

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:311`

### English

Genes Stolen

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:361`

## bio.1065.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.1065.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成功了！我们的特工带着一大堆基因物质满载而归，这样一来在下一次突变时我们又能确保获取巨大的优势了。也许我们还可以发展出对[From.Target.GetSpeciesName]的一些口味偏好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:312`

### English

It is done! Our operatives have come away with a wealth of genetic material. We are sure to see great advancements when next we mutate. Perhaps we might even develop a taste for the [From.Target.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:362`

The alterations we implement now will reshape our future.

## bio.50.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.50.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于我们对基因纯净的侧重，得到增益的公民们开始认为自己天生就比其他人优越。由于这种优越感，他们要求更短的工作时间、更多的便利设施和更多的政治权力。他们日益激烈的集会正在造成严重的社会混乱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:367`

### English

As a result of our focus on genetic purification, augmented citizens have begun to view themselves as inherently superior to the rest of the population. They demand shorter work days, more amenities, and stronger political power due to their perceived superiority. Their increasingly aggressive rallies are causing significant societal disruption.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:427`

## bio.55.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.55.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

新闻公报上充斥着分裂言论，分歧正在撕裂社会。得到改良基因的人获得了更多的机会，由此催生了一种新的阶级斗争。\n\n基因增强者相信他们代表了我们物种的未来，而传统主义者则认为我们在非自然领域走得太远了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:371`

### English

Divisive rhetoric dominates news bulletins, and disagreements are tearing social units apart. A new kind of class struggle is emerging, as more opportunities fall to those with modified genes.\n\nThe genetically enhanced believe they represent the future of our species, while traditionalists feel we are straying too far into unnatural territory.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:432`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:433`

### English

Perhaps we are moving too fast.

基因鸿沟

Acidic Disparity

## bio.60.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.60.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在某些行业，纯度检测滥用愈发司空见惯。那些被认为拥有优越基因组成的人在工作、教育方面将受到优待，并被盲目地授予更容易获得权力的职位。\n\n虽然一些人认为，生物增强的个体确实更强壮、更健康，但另一些人则认为，这种心态对那些不愿或无法改变基因组以追求基因完美的人造成了不当的歧视。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:375`

### English

Arbitrary purity tests are becoming commonplace in some industries. Those deemed to have superior genetic makeup are receiving preferential treatment in work, education, and blindly granted easier access to positions of power.\n\nWhile some argue that individuals with bio-enhancements are indeed stronger and healthier, others contend that this mindset creates undue discrimination for those unwilling or unable to alter their genomes in the pursuit of genetic perfection.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:437`

### English

## bio.65.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.65.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对纯洁的追求使某些人敢于在公共安全方面发挥突出作用。由于拥有超强的力量、敏捷和耐力，一小群行善者将自己塑造成侠客，将法律掌握在自己[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。\n\n然而，这种新颖的勇气并非无人挑战。在阴影中，同样强大的对手正在出现，他们的的邪恶意图是达成力量的平衡。两个阵营之间的冲突造成重大财产损失，甚至危及平民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:379`

### English

Our push for purity has emboldened certain individuals to assume a prominent role in public safety. Enhanced with super strength, agility, and endurance, small gangs of do-gooders are styling themselves as champions, taking the law into their own [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].\n\nHowever, this newfound valor has not gone unchallenged. In the shadows, equally augmented adversaries are emerging, their malevolent intentions fueled by a desire to balance the scales of power. Clashes between the two camps are causing significant property damage and even endangering civilians.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:442`

## bio.66.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.66.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

超能力个体的活动已经被取缔了，他们现在受到了严格的的规定限制。我们正着力监视并遏制这种活动。\n\n当我们努力确保他们只使用自己的力量为帝国服务时，超能力者和未增强者感受到了越来越多的恐惧和蔑视。我们的人民在这个问题上有着严重的分歧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:384`

### English

We have clamped down on the activities of super-powered individuals. These beings now face harsh restrictions and regulations. Our surveillance efforts have allowed us to monitor and curb their activities.\n\nWhile we work hard to ensure they only use their powers in service to our empire, there is growing fear and disdain among the super-powered and the un-augmented. Our population is heavily divided on this matter.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:448`

## bio.67.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.67.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对基因强化义警的依赖程度与日俱增，这已成为一把双刃剑。虽然这些存在为我们带来了安全感和福祉，但我们也清楚地意识到自己对他们的依赖程度。\n\n民众虽然心怀感激，但现在他们开始绕过司法程序和行政官，转而向这些超能力者寻求指导和支持。英雄与政府之间的界限已经模糊。权力正处于一个微妙的平衡点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:388`

### English

Our increasing reliance on genetically enhanced vigilantes has become a double-edged sword. While these beings provide us a sense of safety and wellbeing, it is not lost on us how much we have come to depend on them.\n\nThe people are grateful, but they now turn to these super-powered individuals for guidance and support, bypassing the judiciary process and ignoring officials. The distinction between the heroes and the government has blurred. Power hangs in the balance.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:453`

## bio.70.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.70.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一位因其不知疲倦的工作态度而在全星系备受赞誉的杰出领袖，被揭露其实不是一个人，而是两个人。\n\n事实表明，这位领袖获得了一个完美克隆体，让两人能够轮班工作。当一个克隆体在执行公务和处理行政事务时，另一个则在秘密休息和恢复。\n\n这一揭露在政治领域掀起了轩然大波，引发了人们对领导力本质和克隆技术伦理界限的质疑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:392`

### English

A prominent leader, celebrated galaxy-wide for their tireless work ethic, has been revealed to be not one, but two individuals.\n\nIt has come to light that this leader obtained a perfect clone, allowing each to work in alternating shifts. While one clone engaged in public duties and administrative toil, the other would rest and recuperate in secrecy.\n\nThis revelation has sent shockwaves through the political landscape, calling into question the true nature of leadership and the ethical boundaries of cloning technology.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:458`

### English

## bio.75.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.75.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

委托制造克隆体用于器官摘取的做法已经引发了问题。一些明显具有感知能力的克隆体，正在通过长期绝食的方式进行反抗。\n\n虽然许多人认为原体的健康和长寿应当优先考虑，但也有人主张每个具有思维能力的存在都应当拥有个人自主权。这个有争议的问题现已成为激烈辩论的焦点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:396`

### English

The practice of commissioning clones for organ harvesting is already leading to complications. Several clones, obviously possessing sentience, are rebelling by means of a protracted hunger strike.\n\nWhile many argue that the health and longevity of an original should take precedence, others contend that every thinking being has the right to personal autonomy. This contentious issue is now a subject of heated debate.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:463`

## bio.80.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.80.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

执法部门陷入了两难境地。我们首都的犯罪率正在上升，但被绳之以法的人却比以往任何时候都少。嫌疑人越来越多地以其克隆体犯案为由进行辩护。\n\n一旦没有人赃并获，就几乎不可能证明嫌犯的罪行。一些司法人员现在呼吁废除大多数非法行为的罪名。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:400`

### English

Law enforcement is in a quandary. Crime in our capital is on the rise, yet fewer people than ever are facing justice. Suspected criminals are increasingly pleading not guilty, claiming their clones committed the offenses.\n\nIn cases where suspects are not caught in the act, it has become nearly impossible to prove guilt. Some judiciaries are now calling for the effective decriminalization of most illicit activities.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:468`

## bio.85.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.85.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们的境内发现了一座未经授权的大型克隆设施，里面安置着数千个复制人，每一个都是我们[Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Owner.Leader.GetName]的复制品。现场发现的平民科学家已被拘留，但没有人愿意合作，都声称不知道是谁下令制造这些克隆体。\n\n零星的证据表明[Owner.Leader.GetName][Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself]自己可能是这一行动的幕后主使。不幸的是，[Owner.Leader.GetSheHe]已经消失得无影无踪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:404`

### English

A massive unsanctioned cloning facility has been uncovered within our borders, housing thousands of doppelgangers, each a replica of our [Owner.Leader.GetTitle], [Owner.Leader.GetName]. Civilian scientists found on-site have been taken into custody, but none are cooperating, claiming ignorance of who ordered the clones.\n\nSparse evidence suggests [Owner.Leader.GetName] [Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself] may be behind this operation. Unfortunately, [Owner.Leader.GetSheHe] vanished without a trace.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:473`

## bio.86.desc

### 中文

对如此多克隆体实施安乐死的做法引发了公众愤怒，并引发了严肃的争论。不满的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]权利活动人士和宗教团体正在举行大规模抗议。\n\n与此同时，有传言称一些克隆体已经逃脱，正潜伏在普通民众之中。

### English

Euthanizing so many clones has sparked outrage and triggered serious debate. Disgruntled [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] rights activists and religious groups are staging large scale protests.\n\nMeanwhile, there are rumors that some of the clones escaped, and are lurking among the general public.

## bio.90.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.90.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

许多具有显著或非常规基因变异的个体已被社会排斥。被迫转入地下的这些变种人已经形成了他们自己的聚居地。\n\n那些冒险进入这些区域的人很少能够回来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:416`

### English

Many individuals with prominent or unconventional genetic mutations have been ostracized from society. Forced underground, these mutants have formed their own enclaves.\n\nThose who venture into these areas seldom return.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:487`

## bio.95.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.95.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

失意的年轻人开始以极端娱乐的方式剧烈改变自己的外貌。\n\n最新的潮流包括对复眼的狂热追求，以及比拼在一个身体上能够添加多少额外肢体，目前的记录是156个。\n\n这些生物黑客已经引起了公众关注，引发了安全方面的担忧。随着对基因变异进行严格限制的呼声日益高涨，我们必须确定官方立场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:420`

### English

Disenfranchised youths have begun drastically altering their appearances as a form of extreme amusement.\n\nThe latest trends include a mania for compound eyes, and competitions to see how many additional limbs are possible on a single body, with the current record set at 156.\n\nThese biohackers have garnered public attention, raising safety concerns. As calls for strict restrictions on genetic mutations grow louder, we must decide our official stance.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:492`

### English

## bio.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们的文明中广泛采用基因操作技术催生出了令人目不暇接的各种身体变异。\n\n一些原本可预测的生理过程现在出现了意外的偏差，使得标准化几乎不可能实现。\n\n曾经统一我们物种的身体共性正在消解，取而代之的是一个由各种形态和功能组成的万花筒，这正在动摇社会的凝聚力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:424`

### English

The widespread adoption of genetic manipulation across our civilization has spawned a bewildering array of physical variations.\n\nOnce predictable biological processes now exhibit unexpected deviations, making standardization nearly impossible.\n\nThe shared sense of physical commonality that once unified our species is dissolving, replaced by a kaleidoscope of forms and functions that strain societal cohesion.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:497`

### English

## bio.105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一项转基因实验灾难性地失败了。科学家们试图将测试对象的DNA与其他多细胞生物的DNA进行拼接，以激活超级免疫反应，使其对所有病毒都具有免疫力。\n\n然而，他们反而创造出了一种能够溶解接触到的任何生物体细胞壁的生物，它会与接触对象融合，形成一团巨大的、无定形的生物质团。\n\n这团生物质在测试设施中滚动前进，吞噬了沿途的一切。目前它已被控制住，但如果逃脱的话将会造成重大的健康危害。值得庆幸的是，它似乎是可食用的...

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:429`

### English

A transgenic experiment has gone disastrously wrong. Scientists attempted to splice the DNA of test subjects with that of other multicellular organisms to activate a hyperimmune response, rendering them impervious to all viruses.\n\nInstead, they created a creature that dissolves the cell walls of any organism it contacts, fusing with it to become one large, amorphous mass of biological material.\n\nThis blob rolled through the test facility, absorbing everything in its path. It has been contained for now, but poses a significant health hazard if it escapes. Thankfully, it also appears edible...

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:503`

### English

## bio.110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们开始对[target.GetGestaltEntityName]进行生物提升时，我们必须优先考虑那些最能使我们的文明受益的强化项目。\n\n选择性基因操控让我们能够培育出最适合特定的工业领域的理想体征。\n\n有了这些新获得的能力，我们可以选择强化能源生产领域或防御领域的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:472`

### English

As we begin to biologically uplift the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], we must prioritize only those enhancements that will most benefit our civilization.\n\nSelective gene manipulation allows us to breed specialists with desirable physical features who are best suited to specific industries.\n\nWith these newfound abilities, we have the opportunity to either bolster [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] who work in energy production, or defense.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:555`

### English

## bio.115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在给工蜂制定新的模板时，必须决定好如何处理那些无法承受基因升级的个体。\n\n有一些较老的工蜂过于虚弱无法承受调整。可以将其保留作劳动力度过余生，或将回收他们的生物质补给蜂巢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:476`

### English

As we introduce a new biological template for our drones, we must decide how to handle those incompatible with the genetic upgrade.\n\nSome older drones lack the strength to endure the alterations. We could either retain them as labor for the remainder of their lifespan, or recycle their biomatter to replenish the hive.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:560`

## bio.120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一项突破性基因研究揭示了一种增强神经传递效率的方式，可以显著提升[target.GetIndividualName]的产出。\n\n然而，这种对大脑输出功率的提升并不能长期维持，会导致寿命缩短。\n\n我们必须决定是要保持正常的寿命或是以长寿为代价换取更强的能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:480`

### English

A breakthrough in genetic research has revealed a way to enhance neural relay efficiency, significantly boosting [target.GetIndividualName] productivity.\n\nHowever, this increase in brain output is not sustainable over a long period, leading to a shorter lifespan.\n\nWe must decide whether to retain our regular lifespans or develop heightened functioning at the cost of longevity.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:565`

## bio.125.name

### 中文

突触过载

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:569`

## bio.125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一批新增强的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经集成到了[target.GetGestaltEntityName]中，它们经过生物工程的微调，加速了神经发育和认知过程。[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的关键突触节点正以前所未有的速度运转。\n\n然而，这种加速破坏了[target.GetIndividualName]的稳定性，有可能造成灾难性的突触过载。我们或许还可以重新分配更多的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]来执行协调任务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:484`

### English

A batch of newly augmented [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has been integrated into the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], their biological engineering fine-tuned to accelerate neural development and cognitive processes. The [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s key synaptic nodes are now operating at an unprecedented pace.\n\nYet, this acceleration has strained the [target.GetIndividualName]'s stability, risking catastrophic synaptic overload. Alternatively, we could reallocate more [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] to coordination tasks.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:570`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.130.name&lang=en)

### 中文

频率现象

### English

Frequency Phenomena

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:574`

## bio.130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从将新一批克隆体整合进蜂巢后，我们发现了一种令人不快的声音振动问题。克隆过程中的一个失误可能阻碍了它们的生物递质的发育，产生了频率干扰。\n\n这些克隆体与蜂巢整体进行交流时，附近的所有工蜂都会被一阵嘈杂而令人不安的精神耳鸣的影响。这分散了工蜂的注意力，也影响到了工作效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:488`

### English

Since integrating a new batch of clones into our hive, we have observed unpleasant audio-vibratory issues. A misstep in the cloning process may have stunted the development of their biological transmitters, causing frequency interference.\n\nWhen these clones commune with the wider hive, all nearby drones are subjected to loud and unsettling bouts of mental tinnitus. Distractions are high, and productivity is at risk.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:575`

### English

## bio.135.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.135.name&lang=en)

### 中文

同步行动之谜

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:491`

### English

A Moving Problem

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:579`

## bio.135.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

近期克隆实验取得了异常结果。部分克隆体似乎与基因供体之间存在神经连接，导致他们无意识地同步行动。\n\n无论距离多远，这种现象始终存在，克隆体会与星系其他位置的供体完全同步。这一发现为我们带来了新的可能性。\n\n我们可以启动一项计划，将克隆体与供体置于相同环境中协同工作；或者提取相关神经递质，以深入研究这一现象。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:492`

### English

Recent Cloning experiments have yielded unusual results. Some clones appear to be neurologically linked to their genetic donors, causing them to unintentionally move in tandem.\n\nThe phenomenon persists no matter the distance, with individual drones mirroring the actions of their counterparts elsewhere in the galaxy. This presents some intriguing possibilities.\n\nWe could implement an initiative that brings clones and donors together to work in tandem in identical environments. Alternatively, we could extract the responsible neurotransmitters to better study the phenomenon.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:580`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.135.a&lang=en)

### English

Set up identical workstations for donor and clone.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:581`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.135.b&lang=en)

### English

Surgically sever the synchronous links.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:582`

## bio.140.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.140.name&lang=en)

### 中文

不兼容克隆

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:495`

### English

Incompatible Clones

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:584`

## bio.140.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.140.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了巩固蜂巢，我们用供体材料培育了一批克隆体并人工加速了它们的成熟。虽然这些克隆体是优良的生物标本，但却不可兼容。\n\n这种反常虽然令人不安，但也提供了一个独特的机会。这些独特的工蜂拥有独立的身份和思想，在与集体之外的实体交互时可能会更加有利。它们自主思考的能力也可以弥合蜂巢统一意识难以跨过的鸿沟。然而这些好处是有代价的：他们日益增强的个体意识导致了不安，将会影响我们的一些高级认知功能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:496`

### English

In an attempt to bolster the hive, we cultivated a batch of clones from donor material and artificially accelerated their maturity. Though fine biological specimens, these clones are incompatible.\n\nThis deviation, while troubling, presents a unique opportunity. These individuated drones, now possessing singular identities and independent thought, may prove advantageous in interfacing with entities outside the collective. Their ability to think autonomously could bridge gaps where the hive's unified voice struggles to adapt. Yet, these benefits come at a cost: their growing awareness of individuality has led to unrest, affecting some of our higher-level cognitive functions.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:585`

### 中文

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:589`

## bio.145.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.145.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的集体意识处于混乱之中。尽管拥有了自我复制的能力，但我们却对这种行为的有效性（甚至道德性）犹豫不决。\n\n克隆工序需要大量资源。尤其在自然繁殖可能产生更多基因多样性的情况下，我们是否更应该将这些资源花费在更其他地方？\n\n在历史上这不是我们的繁殖方式，我们不确定是否准备好接受这种对自己物种的根本改变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:500`

### English

Our collective consciousness is in turmoil. We now possess the ability to create copies of ourselves, yet we hesitate, questioning the efficacy (and even the morality) of such actions.\n\nCloning processes require significant resources. Might these be better spent elsewhere, particularly as natural procreation is likely to produce more genetic diversity?\n\nHistorically, this has not been our method of procreation, and we are uncertain if we are ready to embrace such a fundamental change to our species.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:590`

## bio.150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的变异实验导致蜂巢内部出现异常。以往轻轻松松的任务现在都要三思后行，相互冲突的指令使集体精神紧张。\n\n虽然由此产生的重负可能会烧毁我们最得力的工蜂，但它也提供了一个机会。\n\n我们必须决定：应该放慢脚步修复，还是让自己超越极限？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:504`

### English

Our mutational experiments have caused irregularities within the hive. Tasks that once unfolded with ease now demand deliberate effort, as conflicting directives strain the collective mind.\n\nWhile the resulting fatigue threatens to burn out some of our most effective drones, it also presents an opportunity.\n\nWe must decide: will we pause to recover or push ourselves past our limits?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:595`

## bio.151.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.151.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们做出的休整决定带来了好处。之前那些不和谐的冲动逐渐安定下来，凝聚成一股和谐的思想之流，再次清晰地推动着集体。\n\n曾经在精疲力竭的边缘摇摇欲坠的工蜂又开始不知疲倦地精确工作。这段时间的反思不仅减轻了集体疲劳，而且也增强了我们应对未来挑战的决心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:508`

### English

Our decision to rest and recover has borne fruit. The once-discordant impulses have settled, coalescing into a harmonious flow of thought that propels the collective with renewed clarity.\n\nDrones that once teetered on the brink of burnout now work with tireless precision. This period of reflection has not only reduced our collective fatigue, but also fortified our resolve for the challenges ahead.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:600`

## bio.155.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.155.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

变异带来很多好处，而我们的蜂巢能利用选择性增来进一步满足需求。可以通过硬化几丁质附肢实现对矿物产出的特化。\n\n或者我们可以让所有工蜂获得更多基因修饰，让他们拥有多种不同功能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:511`

### English

Mutation offers many benefits, and through selective enhancements, we can adapt the hive to better serve its purpose. Specialization in mineral production can now be achieved by hardened, chitinous appendages.\n\nAlternatively, we could augment all drones with more generic modifications, enabling them to perform a multitude of functions.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:604`

## bio.160.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.160.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

持续的实验给蜂巢带来了意想不到的复杂性。一些工蜂出现了独特的身体特征：像是带刺的外骨骼、过大的附肢，或者异常敏感的感官器官。\n\n虽然这些变化确实带来了一定的好处，但同时也增加了代谢负担。蜂巢面临着平衡这种不断加剧的压力的问题。关键在于，要进行多少变异才算合适呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:515`

### English

Ongoing experimentation has introduced unexpected complexities to the hive. Drones are emerging with unique physical characteristics: spiked exoskeletons, oversized appendages, or oddly sensitive sense organs.\n\nWhile these deviations provide definite benefits, they also introduce a metabolic burden. The hive struggles to balance this escalating strain. The question looms: how much mutation is enough?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:609`

## bio.165.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.165.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

蜂巢正在改变。通过基因组的改造，我们观察到了显著的健康改善。然而，这也使我们在面对心理压力时变得更加脆弱。\n\n我们并不讨厌从前的自己，尽管我们正在变得更强大、认知能力更先进，但我们仍然怀念过去那些熟悉的思维模式。\n\n整个蜂巢都弥漫着一种深深的不适感，仿佛我们的身体与内在的心灵不再匹配。我们是否已经超越了自我的界限？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:519`

### English

The hive is changing. By altering our genomes, we have observed measurable health improvements. However, this has made us less resilient to psychological distress.\n\nWe did not dislike who we were before, and even though we are becoming a stronger and more cognitively advanced, we miss the familiarity of our former thought patterns.\n\nThroughout the hive there is a deeply uncomfortable feeling that our bodies do not match our intrinsic psyche. Have we outgrown ourselves?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:614`

### 中文

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:906`

## bio.170.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.170.name&lang=en)

### 中文

纯净：政府改革？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:749`

### English

Purity: Government Reformation?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:952`

## bio.170.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.170.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的物种正站在下一个宏伟前沿的边缘。我们现在必须做出选择。\n\n我们是要拥抱我们的命运，净化我们的基因谱系，将我们的文明提升到基因卓越的新高度？还是要保留我们过去的教训，以当前未经提炼的形态继续前进？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:750`

### English

Our species stands on the edge of its next grand frontier. We must now make a choice.\n\nWill we embrace our destiny, purifying our genetic lineage to elevate our civilization to new heights of genetic excellence? Or will we retain the lessons of our past and continue in our current, unrefined form?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:953`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:960`

## bio.175.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.175.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的物种已经到达关键时刻。必须做出决定。\n\n我们是要拥抱命运，驾驭克隆的力量，不可逆转地将自身转变为一个复制完美的文明？还是要吸收迄今为止旅程的教训，继续保持我们不必要的差异化？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:756`

### English

Our species has arrived at a crucial moment. A decision must be made.\n\nShall we embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of cloning, irrevocably transforming ourselves into a civilization of replicated perfection? Or shall we absorb the lessons of our journey so far and persist in our needless differentiation?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:961`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:962`

## bio.180.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.180.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正处在关键生物前沿的风口浪尖。一个重要的抉择在等待着我们。\n\n我们可以通过驾驭高级生物突变的力量来拥抱我们的命运，通过对我们基因密码的刻意进化来不可逆转地改变我们的文明。或者我们可以保留从过去探索中获得的教训，继续保持我们当前平凡的形态。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:762`

### English

We are on the cusp of a pivotal biological frontier. An important choice awaits.\n\nWe can either embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of advanced biological mutation, irrevocably transforming our civilization through the deliberate evolution of our genetic code. Or we can preserve the lessons gained from our past exploits and continue in our current, mundane form.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:969`

## bio.200.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.200.name&lang=en)

### 中文

拥抱我们的传承

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:785`

### English

Embracing our Legacy

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:998`

## bio.200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们专注于净化我们的基因，我们正在认识到所有使我们文明伟大的事物。\n\n当我们变得比以往任何时候都更加纯净，我们对我们优越的传承感到前所未有的自豪。\n\n来自各个领域的专家；艺术界、科学界和商界，都在为我们的集体努力欢呼，并希望引领我们走向荣耀。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:786`

### English

Complimenting the concentrated focus on purifying our genetics, we are realizing all the things that make our civilization great.\n\nAs we become purer than ever, we have never been more proud of our superior heritage.\n\nExperts from all fields; the arts, science, and business, are all cheering on our collective efforts, and hoping to lead the way to our glory.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:999`

## bio.200.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.200.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将通过资助艺术来庆祝这一里程碑！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:787`

### English

We will celebrate this milestone by funding the arts!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1000`

## bio.200.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.200.b&lang=en)

### 中文

科学研究必须永远放在首位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:788`

### English

Scientific research must always come first.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1001`

## bio.200.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.200.c&lang=en)

消费是经济的核心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:789`

### English

Consumption is the core of the economy.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1002`

## bio.210.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.210.name&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不会被纯化！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:790`

### English

We will not be purified!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1004`

## bio.210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

抗议者的呼喊在我们的城市中回荡。帝国内部的一个叛逆派系已经擅自拒绝我们的事业，背离我们通向纯净的道路。\n\n这些麻烦制造者宣扬所谓基因多样性和文化融合的需求。\n\n如果他们的激进行为得不到处理，我们通向纯净的进程可能会受阻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:791`

### English

Chants from protesters echo through our cities. A rebellious faction within our empire has taken it upon themselves to reject our cause, and turn away from our path to purity.\n\nThese troublemakers preach the supposed need for genetic diversity, and cultural integration.\n\nIf their activism continues unaddressed, there is a risk that our progress toward purity could falter.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1005`

## bio.210.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.210.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:792`

### English

Stamp out these dissidents!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1006`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.210.b&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1007`

## bio.215.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.215.name&lang=en)

### 中文

过往的秘密

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:794`

### English

Secrets of the Past

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1009`

## bio.215.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.215.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

考古学家在我们祖先母星上发现了一个古代文明的证据。\n\n一个长期掩埋的地下库被发掘出来，其中有令人震惊的远古基因实验证据。\n\n如果这个消息公之于众，可能会削弱我们现代对基因纯净的主张。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:795`

### English

Archaeologists have discovered proof of an ancient civilization from our ancestral homeworld.\n\nA long buried vault has been uncovered, and within there is startling evidence of past genetic experimentation.\n\nIf this news became public knowledge, it could dilute our modern claims to genetic purity.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1010`

## bio.215.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.215.a&lang=en)

### 中文

将这项研究与我们的研究整合。在过去的基础上发展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:796`

### English

Integrate this research with our own. Build upon the past.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1011`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1012`

## bio.220.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.220.name&lang=en)

### 中文

怪诞科学

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:798`

### English

Weird Science

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1014`

## bio.220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一位名为[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]的叛逆基因学家被发现进行未经批准的生物实验。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer]无视任何安全准则，目标是创造一个体现我们所追求的纯净理想的优等种族。然而，[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe]却创造出了一个畸形怪物。\n\n现在，一个短命的亚种正在我们的监管下逐渐消亡，它们虽然与我们的基因特征有一些相似之处，但大多是疾病缠身的恐怖存在。尽管对它们基因构成的研究富有成效，但预后是致命的。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]对此毫无悔意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:799`

### English

A rogue geneticist by the name of [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] has been found conducting unsanctioned biological experiments. Bypassing any safety guidelines, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer] goal was to create a race of superior beings who would embody the ideals of purity that we strive for. Instead, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe] birthed an abomination.\n\n A subspecies of short lived creatures, who share some aspects of our genetic profile, but are mostly disease-ridden horrors, are now withering away in our custody. Though study of their genetic makeup has proven fruitful, prognosis is terminal. [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] is unrepentant.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1015`

## bio.225.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.225.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了加快我们通向纯净的道路并识别基因组异常者，我们推行了定期基因检测，拥有'高质量'DNA已成为一种炫耀资本。\n\n据称某些帝国官员一直在谎报他们的生物特征，伪造检测结果以表明他们拥有比实际更理想的特质。如果这件事曝光，这种对真相的隐瞒必将激起公众的愤怒。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:805`

### English

Having rolled out regular genetic testing to streamline our path toward purity, and identify genomic outliers, 'high quality' DNA has become something to boast about.\n\nCertain empire officials have supposedly been lying about their biological makeup, forging test results that suggest they have more desirable traits than they do in reality. If it comes to light, this concealment of truth threatens to outrage the public.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1022`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:806`

### English

We need more accurate and reliable testing.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1023`

## bio.230.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.230.name&lang=en)

### 中文

克隆困境

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:811`

### English

The Clone Dilemma

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1030`

## bio.230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

克隆人就在我们之中。他们生活在我们的城市里，在我们的工厂里工作。有些甚至身居要职，参与制定影响我们生活的政策。\n\n随着克隆个体融入我们的社会，许多问题仍未得到解答。他们应该享有什么权利？他们是否与非克隆人平等，还是应该作为下属被管控？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:812`

### English

Clones walk among us. They live in our cities, they work in our factories. Some of them are even in positions of power, shaping the very policies that govern our lives.\n\nWith the integration of cloned individuals into our society, there remain many unanswered questions. What are their rights? Are they equal to non-clones, or should they be kept in line as subordinates?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1031`

## bio.230.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.230.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:813`

### English

Full citizenship for all clones!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1032`

### English

They are second-class citizens at best.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1033`

## bio.235.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.235.name&lang=en)

### 中文

克隆工厂遭到破坏！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:815`

### English

Sabotage at the Clone Plant!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1035`

## bio.235.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.235.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最具生产力的克隆设施之一因一起事故而突然停产，造成重大损失。\n\n由于我们的许多操作都为了效率而自动化，在关键时刻没有人能够及时介入处理这次事故。\n\n一个刚下生产线的克隆人滑倒，卷入机械装置中被碾碎，导致生产线堵塞，不得不完全停产。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:816`

### English

Clone production at one of our most productive facilities has been halted suddenly due to an incident which caused significant damage.\n\nAs many of our operations are automated for efficiency, there was nobody to intervene at a key moment which led to the disturbance.\n\nFresh off the conveyor belt, one of the clones slipped and found themself caught in the mechanisms, grinding them up, causing a pile up, and necessitating a full stop on production.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1036`

### English

## bio.240.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.240.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们帝国各地的克隆人都在报告他们正在经历困扰，在寻找自我认同感方面苦苦挣扎。\n\n他们渴望拥有超越其基因捐献者的身份认同。他们质疑自己存在的意义，对生活目标和抱负感到茫然。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:822`

### English

Clones across our empire are reporting struggles, grappling with their sense of self.\n\nThey long for an identity beyond that of their genetic donors. They question their very purpose, feeling listless regarding their life goals and aspirations.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1043`

## bio.240.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.240.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这很常见。去做心理治疗吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:823`

## bio.250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着更多克隆人融入我们的人口，维持他们生存所需的额外资源开始给经济带来压力。\n\n虽然眼前的挑战重重，但更大的劳动力和消费群体带来的经济活力可能会为长期繁荣奠定基础——前提是我们能有效管理这个过渡期。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:827`

### English

As more clones are integrated into our population, the additional resources required to sustain them are beginning to strain the economy.\n\nWhile the immediate challenges are significant, the economic dynamism brought about by a larger workforce and consumer base could lay the foundation for long-term prosperity - provided we can manage the transition effectively.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1049`

Our infrastructure must grow to meet demand.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1050`

## bio.260.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.260.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自发的肢体生长。物质形态的波动。突发性的形态转变。这些报告虽然零星，但不容忽视。\n\n我们的变异实验在整个文明中产生了一些不太理想的结果。也许解锁随意修改基因的工具比我们最初预想的要复杂得多。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:834`

### English

Spontaneous limb growth. Fluctuations between states of matter. Sudden onset metamorphosis. These reports are few and far between, but they cannot be ignored.\n\nOur experiments with mutation are garnering some less than desirable results across our civilization. Perhaps unlocking the tools to modify one's genes at will was more than we initially bargained for.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1058`

## bio.265.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.265.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于自行进行变异实验，我们的一小部分人口发展出了非凡的能力和身体强化。\n\n作为独特的强者和天赋者，他们正在形成一个群体，并引起了公众的广泛关注。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:840`

### English

A small percentage of our population has developed extraordinary abilities and physical enhancements due to their own experiments with mutation.\n\nAs uniquely strong and gifted people, they are forming a community and garnering a lot of attention from the public.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1065`

### English

## bio.270.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.270.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

监控确认了一群基因改造者居住在城市下水道系统的存在——这令人不安地印证了长期被忽视的都市传说。\n\n这一发现加剧了社会紧张，随着对未知的恐惧升级，外表明显变异的公民报告遭受更多歧视。然而，这些个体展现出了非凡的创造力，以意想不到的方式利用下水道气体进行资源生产并改造他们的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:847`

### English

Surveillance has confirmed the existence of a population of genetically altered individuals inhabiting urban sewer systems - an unsettling echo of long-dismissed urban legends.\n\nThis discovery has heightened social tensions, with visibly mutated citizens reporting increased discrimination as fears of the unknown escalate. Nevertheless, these individuals have demonstrated remarkable ingenuity, harnessing sewer gases for resource production and adapting their environment in unexpected ways.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1073`

### English

变异传染

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1077`

## bio.280.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.280.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种新疾病正在我们的帝国蔓延。这种疾病导致一系列令人不适的症状，包括但不限于：不自主的气体和液体排出、极度疲劳，某些情况下甚至会致命。\n\n最奇特的是，这种疾病只影响那些通过基因变异改变了生理特征的人。对他们改造后基因组的持续研究带来了一些令人惊讶的发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:851`

### English

An outbreak of a new disease is spreading across our empire. The illness causes a host of unpleasant symptoms, including but not limited to: involuntary expulsions of air and liquid, debilitating fatigue, and in some cases loss of life.\n\nMost curiously, this disease is only affecting those who have altered their physiology in certain ways with genetic mutations. Ongoing study of their modified genome has led to some surprising insights.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1078`

## bio.295.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.295.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的基因组研究设施为整个文明提供了前所未有的生理改造能力。\n\n然而，帝国的公民们想要更多。他们呼吁打破中央化的资源控制，允许所谓的\"生物黑客\"自由且不受限制地使用基因技术。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:859`

### English

Our Genomic Research Facilities have granted our entire civilization access to physiological alteration unlike anything we have ever experienced.\n\nHowever, the citizens of our empire want more. There are calls for breaking up centralized resources, and allowing so-called "biohackers" free and unrestricted access to gene technology.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1088`

## bio.300.desc

### 中文

一位名为[event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientist]刚刚发表了一篇学术研究，这项研究可能大大加快并提高我们基因实验的效率和效果。\n\n这种新方法目前仅限于理论，尚未经过测试，因此要安全地应用到我们的工作中还需要仔细考虑其方法论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:864`

### English

A [Owner.GetScientist] by the name of [event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName] has just published a piece of academic research that could be used to dramatically accelerate and improve the efficiency and efficacy of our genetic experimentations.\n\nPurely theoretical, the new method has not been tested, so the methodology will require some careful consideration in order to be applied safely to our processes.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1094`

## bio.310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于我们持续的基因改造实验，我们的物种已被一段失控的基因代码侵入。我们正以惊人的速度变得虚弱，这段外来序列与我们自身基因物质的不受控制的相互作用正在破坏我们的稳定性。\n\n我们必须在为时已晚之前解决这种异常的生物行为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:872`

### English

Our species has been infiltrated by a piece of rogue genetic code, a consequence of our persistent experimentation in genetic modification. We are becoming unwell at an alarming rate, destabilized by the unregulated interaction of this foreign sequence with our own genetic material.\n\nWe must address this anomalous biological behavior before it is too late.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1104`

## bio.315.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.315.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如果我们的文明要达到纯净，我们必须首先考虑[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的福祉。基因改造过程必须确保每一个适应性改变都能增强集体的韧性。\n\n走错方向——引入导致不稳定或破坏凝聚力的改变——可能会是灾难性的，威胁到我们统一的根基。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:876`

### English

If our civilization is to become pure, we must first consider the wellbeing of the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]. The genetic modification process must ensure that every adaptation enhances the collective's resilience.\n\nStarting off on the wrong path - introducing changes that cause instability or undermine cohesion - could be disastrous, threatening the very foundation of our unity.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1109`

## bio.325.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.325.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。\n\n只有通过仔细选择值得延续我们血统的工蜂，我们才能超越自然进化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:880`

### English

In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our species, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.\n\nOnly by carefully selecting the drones worthy of carrying on our lineage, can we transcend beyond natural evolution.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1114`

## bio.325.desc.wilderness

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.325.desc.wilderness&lang=en)

为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。\n\n只有通过仔细选择拥有符合我们集体利益的特质的共生体，我们才能超越自然进化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:881`

### English

In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our symbiotic multitude, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.\n\nOnly by carefully selecting viable symbionts with traits of interest to the collective can we transcend beyond our initial boundaries.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1115`

## bio.330.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.330.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

基因修饰的回报将确保我们的传承，但每个[target.GetIndividualName]的角色、每分努力都必须与我们的纯净愿景保持一致。\n\n我们现在面临一个重大抉择：是否要不惜牺牲适应能力来追求极致完美？还是应该采取更全面的策略，优先建设能够持续支撑这些努力的基础设施？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:885`

### English

The rewards of genetic modification will secure our legacy, but every [target.GetIndividualName]'s role, every ounce of effort, must be aligned with our vision of purity.\n\nWe now face a critical decision: should we optimize for perfection at the cost of adaptability? Or should we embrace a broader strategy, prioritizing the infrastructure required to sustain these efforts?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1120`

## bio.350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一处主要克隆中心发生故障影响到了一些工蜂。克隆过程不知为何遭受到基因污染，导致长出了一批没有思考能力的克隆体。\n\n它们本质上就是活着的物体，完全没有知觉，没有更高的认知功能。在完全找出原因、修正了这个生产问题之前，克隆设施的产出率暂时下降了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:901`

### English

Several drones have been affected following a malfunction at one of our primary Cloning centers. Genetic contaminants somehow entered the duplication process, leading to a batch of clones being grown without the capacity for thought.\n\nThey were essentially biological objects, completely non-sentient with no higher cognitive functions. Until the matter has been fully addressed, and the production problems mended, productivity at the facility is reduced.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1140`

## bio.365.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.365.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的意识内部浮现出了一个疑问：会不会有一天克隆体把我们都取代掉了？\n\n我们在基因复制方面的初步努力进展顺利，使我们不禁好奇起这种高效的繁殖方法是否最终会取代我们的自然繁殖。\n\n如果是这样，那么可能有一天蜂巢里再也没有原生子个体，只有克隆的克隆的克隆……这对我们这个物种究竟意味着什么呢？这个问题没有人知道答案，也让异常见蠢蠢欲动，但我们不得不问。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:906`

### English

From within the consciousness, a question emerges: will clones one day replace us all?\n\nOur initial efforts into genetic duplication are going well, so much so that we are curious if this efficient method of reproduction could eventually overtake our natural practice.\n\nIf so, then one day the hive may no longer contain any original donors, only clones of clones of clones... What does this mean for us as a species? A question without an answer, and one which breeds dissent. But we are compelled to ask.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1146`

## bio.375.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.375.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有了一项发现。通过操控特定基因，我们可以扩展意识的触及范围，使我们的感知能力超越物种原有的极限。\n\n要在整个蜂巢范围内实施这些基因突变需要消耗大量能量，但这样做可能会加深我们对宇宙的理解，以及我们在其中所处位置的认知。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:913`

### English

We have made a discovery. By manipulating specific genes, we can expand the reach of our consciousness to give us heightened senses beyond what we once thought of as the limits of our species.\n\nImplementing these mutations hive-wide will require a great deal of energy, but doing so may deepen our understanding of the universe as well as our place within it.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1155`

## bio.380.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.380.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

蜂巢的多个区域正在经历无法控制的愤怒浪潮，这股情绪波动在共享意识中激起涟漪，放大了我们集体的痛苦与挫折。\n\n最近引入的突变似乎过度刺激了工蜂攻击控制中枢的神经细胞，打破了蜂巢的情绪平衡。冲突事件愈发频繁，一些子个体甚至抛弃了原有任务，开始攻击其他同类。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:918`

### English

Whole sections of the hive are experiencing surges of uncontrolled anger, a surge of emotion that has sent ripples through the shared consciousness, amplifying our collective pain and frustration.\n\nA recently introduced mutation appears to be overstimulating neurocytes in our drones' aggression-control centers, disrupting the hive's emotional balance. Conflicts are erupting more frequently, with some drones abandoning their tasks and attacking others.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1161`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1165`

## bio.385.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.385.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然某些突变确实让我们更强大和强化了我们，但我们发现其他突变却带来了不愉快的副作用。\n\n虽然旨在延长寿命的强化已经成功实施，但这些相同的突变却降低了我们对极端气候的耐受性。\n\n那些经历了这些生物强化的个体在调节体内温度系统时遇到了困难，这种不适感传遍了整个蜂巢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:922`

### English

While some mutations galvanize and enhance us, we are finding that others come with unpleasant side effects.\n\nEnhancements aimed to increase our longevity are being implemented successfully, however these same mutations are lowering our tolerance for extreme climates.\n\nThose of us who have undergone these biological augmentations are having difficulty regulating our internal thermoregulatory systems, and the discomfort is felt throughout the entire hive.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1166`

## bio.385.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.385.a&lang=en)

## bio.390.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.390.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现了两种突变。一种变异能够增强基层子个体的力量，大幅提高劳动效率。另一种则能提升复杂型工蜂的智力，增强解决问题和战略思维的能力。\n\n蜂巢必须决定选择哪条进化道路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:928`

### English

A pair of mutations has been identified. One variant enhances menial drones' strength, greatly improving labor efficiency. The other sharpens complex drones' intellect, boosting problem-solving and strategy.\n\nThe hive must decide which path to embrace.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1173`

## bio.405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们差点没控制住基因瘟疫的突然爆发。\n\n我们对自己的生物学操控引发了基因突变，导致许多[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的身体受到损害。\n\n受影响的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已被隔离，现在必须决定如何继续前进。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:935`

### English

We have barely contained the sudden outbreak of a genetic plague.\n\nManipulating our own biology has triggered rogue mutations in our DNA, leading to many [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] becoming physically compromised.\n\nAffected [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] have been quarantined, and we must now decide how to move forward.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1182`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1183`

## bio.410.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.410.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一个计算失误导致大量工蜂的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。\n\n在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。\n\n然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:939`

### English

A misstep in our calculations has led to the degradation of genetic integrity in a substantial amount of our drones. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.\n\nHaving reviewed the biological calculations involved in uplifting our species, and amended some potentially problematic procedures, we are ready to continue our efforts.\n\nIt is not yet certain however if we have actually rectified the error, or worse, introduced more blunders.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1187`

## bio.410.desc.wilderness

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.410.desc.wilderness&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一个计算失误导致大量共生体的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。\n\n在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。\n\n然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:940`

### English

A misstep in our calculations has led to a degradation of genetic integrity in a significant number of our symbionts. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.\n\nHaving reviewed the calculations involved in adapting our constituent parts, and having amended some imbalanced enzyme slurries, we are ready to continue our efforts.\n\nIt is not yet certain, however, if we have actually rectified the error - or worse, introduced more blunders.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1188`

## concept_automodding_habitability_desc

### 中文

—从预定的特质列表中自动选择与当前星球相匹配的修正。\n—每个殖民地每月检测拥有§Y$concept_automodding_traits$§!的£pop£§H人口§!的次数：§G100§!\n—人口增长和组装建筑将增加每月自动改装£pop£§H人口§!的数量

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1315`

### English

- Modifiers are automatically combined with those from a predetermined list of traits to match the current planet.\n- £pop£ §HPops§! with §Y$concept_automodding_traits$§! checked every month, per Colony: §G100§!\n- Pop Growth and Assembly Buildings increase the number of Auto-Modded £pop£ §HPops§! updated per month.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1617`

## auth_bio_democratic_purity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_democratic_purity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

身体自决是一种权利。国家授权个体按照自己喜欢的方式改造身体。身体就是终极画布，唯一的限制只有想象力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1382`

### English

Bodily self-determination is a right. The state empowers individuals to modify their vessels as they see fit. Limited only by their imagination, the body becomes the ultimate canvas.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1703`

## auth_bio_oligarchic_purity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_oligarchic_purity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

绝对的权力必须托付给遗传上注定的精英，他们是这个文明命运最纯洁、最有能力的公仆。在他们之下，每位公民从事着都根据自身的基因潜质量身定制的职位。只有每个人的命中注定的人生意义可以带来满足，而不是野心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1385`

### English

Absolute power must be entrusted to the genetically ordained elite, the purest and most capable stewards of this civilization's destiny. Beneath them, each citizen fulfills a predefined role, meticulously tailored to their inherited genetic potential. Contentment flows not from ambition, but from accepting one's designated purpose.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1707`

## auth_bio_dictatorial_purity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_dictatorial_purity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该政府将基因和生物特征数据作为先发制人的司法工具，通过仔细检查每位公民的基因密码以寻找犯罪倾向。通过在违规行为发生之前进行干预，这种细致的监督可以确保秩序。真正的正义不是守株待兔，而是未雨绸缪，只有从根源上消除犯罪才能保护社会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1389`

### English

This government wields genetic and biometric data as tools of pre-emptive justice, scrutinizing every citizen's genetic code for criminal predispositions. By intervening before transgression, it ensures order through meticulous oversight. True justice is not reactive but preventive, safeguarding society by eliminating crime at the root.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1712`

## auth_bio_imperial_purity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_imperial_purity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

作为基因卓越的捍卫者，这一政体在孜孜不倦追求生命完美的同时，也延长了其领袖的寿命。社会的昌盛源于最优秀基因的保存与繁衍，开创至高无上的未来。对基因库的严苛管理确保了进步的步伐，以长生与完美为最终馈赠。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1392`

### English

Championing genetic excellence, this government extends its leaders' lifespans while relentlessly pursuing biotic perfection. Society's prosperity hinges on the survival and propagation of only the finest genes, ensuring a future defined by superiority. The unyielding curation of the genetic pool guarantees progress, with longevity and perfection as its ultimate rewards.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1716`

## auth_bio_corporate_purity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_corporate_purity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这家寰宇企业将生命商品化推向极致，以营利为目的培育器官。高端器官能在市场上卖出天价，而\"冗余资产\"则往往流入黑市。神秘的中间人和地下手术师如鱼得水，他们为急切的买家提供服务，确保每一份资产都物尽其用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1395`

### English

This megacorp has perfected the commodification of life itself, cultivating organs for profit. Premium-quality organs command top prices, while "redundant" assets may find their way onto the black market. Shadowy intermediaries and black-market surgeons thrive, catering to desperate buyers and ensuring no asset is ever truly wasted.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1720`

## auth_bio_democratic_cloning_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_democratic_cloning_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个政体将克隆技术视为平等与进步的见证。克隆人与自然出生者并肩而立，他们的声音同样受到重视。全民意志因每一个观点的多样性而更加丰富，无论是否为克隆体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1399`

### English

This government embraces cloning technology as a testament to equality and progress. Clones stand shoulder to shoulder with natural-born individuals, their voices equally valued. The will of the people is enriched by the diversity of every perspective, clone or not.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1726`
