## auth_bio_oligarchic_cloning_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_oligarchic_cloning_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个社会通过将权力锚定在优质克隆体的不朽血脉中，确保其精英阶层的永恒统治。克隆技术不仅保存了他们的基因传承，更使其臻于完美，实现了领导层的无缝延续。每个重要职位都由同一尊贵血脉的改良版本所占据，巩固了他们跨越世代的统治地位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1402`

### English

This society ensures the eternal reign of its elites by anchoring power within the unbroken lineage of superior clones. Cloning technology preserves and perfects their genetic legacy, enabling a seamless continuity of leadership. Every position of influence is occupied by an improved iteration of the same exalted line, entrenching their dominance across generations.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1729`

## auth_bio_dictatorial_cloning_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_dictatorial_cloning_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过严密的基因筛选确保绝对忠诚，只有那些天生具有坚定服从性的个体才会被选作克隆源。这创造了一个自我延续的社会，在这里叛乱不仅不可能发生，在生物学上更是完全无法实现，通过公民基因结构的设计本身来确保永恒的和谐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1405`

### English

Absolute loyalty is ensured through meticulous genetic selection, with only those hardwired for unwavering obedience chosen as cloning stock. This creates a self-perpetuating society where rebellion is not only improbable but biologically impossible, securing unbroken harmony through the very fabric of its citizens' design.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1732`

统治者无可置疑的神圣权威通过克隆得以永存，伟大君主的每一世都继承了前世的智慧与荣光。这种领导层的无缝延续确保了社会的永续进步，在他们的明君治世下维系着一个永恒的黄金时代。

## auth_bio_democratic_mutation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_democratic_mutation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个社会恪守一项信条：个体的形躯犹如圣殿，由己主宰，任凭设计与掌控。在自由不羁与坚定支持的框架下，公民们获得实现独特潜能的力量，得以随心塑造自身与未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1447`

### English

This society upholds the principle that each individual's body is their temple, fully under their own design and control. Within a framework of freedom and unwavering support, citizens are empowered to realize their unique potential, shaping themselves and their futures as they see fit.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1781`

## auth_bio_oligarchic_mutation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_oligarchic_mutation&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1448`

### English

Catalytic Command

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1782`

## auth_bio_oligarchic_mutation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_oligarchic_mutation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

权力集中于一个基因突变优异的精英阶层，赋予他们无与伦比的权威。他们超脱于常规法律之外，运用自身能力守护并引导社会，采取一切必要手段以确保社会的存续与繁荣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1449`

### English

Power is concentrated in an elite class endowed with superior genetic mutations, granting them unparalleled authority. Operating beyond the confines of ordinary law, they wield their abilities to protect and guide society, taking whatever actions are deemed necessary to ensure its survival and prosperity.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1783`

## auth_bio_dictatorial_mutation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_dictatorial_mutation&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1784`

## auth_bio_dictatorial_mutation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_dictatorial_mutation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个社会将基因突变奉为进步的基石。那些安于自然形态的个体将面临即刻拘禁或处决，确保唯有基因优异者才能为物种迈向完美的不懈追求贡献力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1451`

### English

This society mandates genetic mutation as the cornerstone of its advancement. Those who are content to remain as nature made them face immediate internment or termination, ensuring that only the genetically superior contribute to the species' relentless drive toward perfection.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1785`

## auth_bio_imperial_mutation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_imperial_mutation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个帝国拥抱随机突变的不可预测之力，挖掘无尽潜能，培育传统方法永远无法企及的创新与能力。在争夺霸权的竞逐中，突变的混沌成为他们最大的优势，推动他们迈向无可匹敌的至高统治。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1454`

### English

Embracing the unpredictable power of random mutation, this empire taps into untold potential, fostering innovations and abilities that traditional methods could never achieve. In the race for dominance, the chaos of mutation becomes their greatest advantage, propelling them toward unrivaled supremacy.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1788`

## auth_bio_corporate_mutation

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1789`

## auth_bio_corporate_mutation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_corporate_mutation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在这种体制下，器官和身体部件的融资通过灵活的付款计划向所有人开放。一旦出现欠款，将立即被收回器官或没收约定的抵押物。这个体系确保了一个稳定的供需循环，每一个身体部件既是商品，也是契约。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1456`

### English

Under this authority, the financing of organs and body parts is made accessible to all through flexible payment plans. Missed payments result in swift repossession or the forfeiture of agreed-upon collateral. This system ensures a steady supply and demand cycle, where every body part is both a commodity and a commitment.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1790`

## auth_bio_corporate_evopred_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_bio_corporate_evopred_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

国有生物掠食企业通过适应在基因和经济上茁壮成长。随着每一个新的基因组加入到公司的投资组合中，该巨型企业都会进一步完善市场地位，根据每个物种独特的生物学特性定制产品和谈判。毕竟，了解客户的本性能让成交几乎……成为本能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1475`

At BioPredation GLC, they thrive on adaptation - both genetic and economic. With every new genome added to the corporate portfolio, the MegaCorp refines its market position, tailoring products and negotiations to every species' unique biology. After all, understanding a customer's nature makes closing the deal almost... instinctual.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1810`

## origin_starlit_citadel_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_starlit_citadel_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——§H$dsc_name$§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1553`

### English

A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the §H$dsc_name$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1904`

## START_SCREEN_STARLIT_CITADEL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_STARLIT_CITADEL&lang=en)

### 中文

我们并不是天生如此警觉。\n\n[Capital.GetName]是一颗富饶的星球，我们也曾是和平富足的人民。但有一天，这个传送门改变了一切。\n\n这群[GetInvadersLower]不请自来。他们在我们的城市和土地上肆虐，又突然跟他们的凭空出现一样消失得无影无踪。我们曾以为这只是偶然，然而这种入侵便一发不可收拾。它们一次又一次地来袭，变得越来越凶残。\n\n现在，我们即将步入星系，$job_skywatcher_plural$们为此做好了准备。在我们母星的深空中，强大的$dsc_name$静静守望。这是一座坚不可摧的垣壁，抵御[GetInvadersLower]或其他想要摧毁我们的东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1555`

### English

We were not always so vigilant.\n\n[Capital.GetName] is a world of abundance, and once, we were a peaceful and contented people. But all that changed when the portal opened.\n\nWithout warning, the [GetInvadersLower] arrived. They razed our cities, ravaged our lands, and then, as swiftly as they had come, they vanished. We dared hope they would never return. But the invasions resumed, again and again, each attack more brutal than the last.\n\nNow, as we prepare to venture into the galaxy, our $job_skywatcher_plural$ stand ready. High above our world, the formidable $dsc_name$ awaits, a steadfast bulwark against the [GetInvadersLower] and any others who seek our destruction.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1907`

## job_skywatcher_effect_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ajob_skywatcher_effect_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

£job_skywatcher£$job_skywatcher_plural$提升$r_stability$，产生£defense_army£§Y防御部队§!并提升帝国的£mod_country_naval_cap_add£§Y海军容量§!。此外还提升§Y$dsc_name_plural$§!、§Y$starbases$§!及§Y$military_station_small_plural$§!的效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1599`

### English

## bio.2005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$job_skywatcher_plural$汇报事态有令人警觉的进展。\n\n最近在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!的传送门中探测到了一种极其微弱但绝对不会搞错的波动。在过去，类似的扰动总会带来一大波敌意的生物舰船。\n\n如果这些数据真实可信，我们知道我下一波攻击会在数月之内到达。人民的生死存亡再一次交由我们的守卫者们保护了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1625`

### English

Our $job_skywatcher_plural$ have reported an alarming development.\n\nSubtle but unmistakable fluctuations were recently detected within the portal in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. In the past, similar disturbances have heralded waves of hostile biological vessels.\n\nIf these readings hold true, we can expect the next assault within a matter of months. The survival of our people may once again depend on the resolve of our defenders.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1985`

## abandoned_hatchery_chain_1_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aabandoned_hatchery_chain_1_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[GetInvadersLower]攻击了我们数十年。我们的$starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$是第一道防线，但只有解开这些敌人的谜团才能真正带来安全。\n\n每个发现都会带我们向着最终的目标推进，我们终将可以发起反抗，终结我们长久以来的围城。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1628`

### English

The [GetInvadersLower] have attacked us for decades. Our $starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$ stands as the first line of defense, but true safety will only be won by uncovering the truth about our enemies.\n\nWith each discovery, we move closer to the day when we can take our fight to them - and our long siege once and for all.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1989`

### English

## bio.2015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们摧毁的生物舰队残骸在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!不祥地飘荡着。虽然它们几乎成了扭曲的焦炭，但大部分有机物质仍然完好无损，为研究提供了难得的机会。\n\n通过仔细的分析，我们也许能够揭开它们奇特结构的秘密——也许还能对它们出现的神秘传送门有所了解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1630`

### English

The debris left by the annihilated biological fleet drifts ominously through §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. Though twisted and charred, much of the organic material remains intact, offering a rare opportunity for study.\n\nWith careful analysis, we may be able to uncover the secrets of their grotesque construction - and perhaps glean some insight into the enigmatic portal from which they emerge.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1992`

## bio.2020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在费劲地研究了§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!里留下的残骸后，我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]觉得他们应该找到了理解我们星系边缘耸立着的传送门的关键所在。\n\n在这种生物的体内深处，发现了一种有机组织——它似乎与传送门的波动会发生共鸣。通过对该频率进行逆向工程，我们应该可以让自己穿越这个神秘的裂缝。\n\n目前仍需要进一步研究，但我们反击的机会前所未有地触手可及了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1635`

### English

After painstaking study of the biological wreckage left in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] believe they may have the key to understanding the portal that looms at the edge of our system.\n\nDeep within the creatures' tissue, an organic pattern has been identified - one that seems to resonate with the portal's fluctuations. By reverse-engineering this frequency, we should be able to traverse the enigmatic rift ourselves.\n\nFurther research will be necessary, but for the first time the possibility of taking the fight to the enemy is within reach.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:1998`

## abandoned_hatchery_chain_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aabandoned_hatchery_chain_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们又离揭开传送门的奥秘近了一步。尽管还是无法穿越，但我们现在已经拥有了发展必要科技所需的洞见\n\n想要反抗这些敌人，我们需要§Y$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1638`

### English

We are one step closer to unlocking the portal's mysteries. Though passage is not yet possible, we now have the insight needed to develop the necessary technology.\n\nTo bring our fight to the enemy, we require §Y$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2001`

### 中文

Extreme caution is advised.\n\nWe have found the cradle of the enemy.

## bio.2027.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2027.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

盘踞在§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的舰队被摧毁了。在结束前一刻，我们收到了一个来自星系恒星基地的微弱信号，我们目前只翻译出的一条是：\n\n§H“—全部失联！这是他们自己生产的舰船！无论你是谁，请救救我们！”§!\n\n随后，所有的通讯就终止了。如果这真的是一场胜利，我们敌人的集结地给了我们一个战略击毁。也许，可以有一座$starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$沐浴着§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的光，来确保不会再有这样的敌人来威胁我们的文明。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1645`

### English

The fleet guarding §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed. Just before the end, we received a haunting transmission from the system's starbase, one which we have only now translated:\n\n§H" - lost all control! The ships are reproducing by themselves! Please, whoever you are, save us!"§!\n\nSince then, all communication has ceased. If this is indeed victory, our enemy's staging ground offers a strategic opportunity. A new $starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$ may one day shine in the light of §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!, ensuring that such a threat never imperils our civilization again.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2010`

## bio.2030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§!是一片露天坟地。\n\n这颗星球上的优势物种完全被一种奇怪的侵略性生命形式所侵占。进一步的调查显示，它们并不是天然的有机体而是某种生物机器，而且并非建造而是生长而来。\n\n不知是否有可能是这些生物的设计者被自己的创物反噬了？我们的敌人难道完全不知道对他们的行动毫无自知之明，甚至不连我们的存在都不知道吗？\n\n只有一件事可以肯定：无论他们采取了什么措施来控制这场瘟疫，这都导致了他们自己以及他们自动制造的可憎之物的毁灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1657`

### English

§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§! is an open grave.\n\nThe planet's dominant species was completely overrun by a strange and aggressive form of life. Further investigation revealed that these were no natural organisms, but rather biological machines, seemingly grown rather than built.\n\nIs it possible that whoever engineered these creatures was overwhelmed by their own creation? Could our enemy have been completely unaware of their actions against us, or even of our existence?\n\nOnly one thing is certain: whatever measures they took to contain this plague destroyed them, along with their automated abominations.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2023`

## bio.2036.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2036.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在观察生物飞船攻击的过程中发现了一个令人不安的趋势。每一波攻击都显示出更高的协调性、适应性战术以及对我们防御系统的系统性试探。敏感器日志揭示了能量特征的变化和攻击优先级的调整，这些都是策略演变的证据。\n\n这些生物，无论是通过本能还是集体智慧，正变得越来越强大。如果这种模式持续下去，下一波攻击将更加难以抵御。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1670`

### English

We have witnessed a troubling trend in the biological ship attacks. Each wave displays improved coordination, adaptive tactics, and a methodical probing of our defenses. Sensor logs reveal shifts in energy signatures and targeting priorities, evidence of evolving strategies.\n\nThese creatures, whether through instinct or collective intelligence, are becoming more formidable. If this pattern continues, the next wave will be even harder to repel.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2039`

## bio.2040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

传送门另一端的遥测数据揭示了§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的一个关键进展：生物舰船和他们的孵化场都被一支未知的力量摧毁了。\n\n尽管知道[GetInvadersLower]被葬送之后都非常高兴，但我们无法忽视另一支力量也许有一天就会控制住[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系的风险。\n\n我们必须加快脚步确保这一战略要地不会落入到另一个敌人的手中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1675`

### English

Incoming telemetry from the portal reveals a critical development in §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!: both the fleet of biological ships and their hatchery have been destroyed by an unknown force.\n\nEven as we rejoice in knowing that the [GetInvadersLower] have met their end, we cannot ignore the risk that another power may one day seize control of the [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system.\n\nWe must move quickly to secure this strategic location before we face yet another siege.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2045`

## bio.2040.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.2040.a&lang=en)

### 中文

是敌……亦或是友？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1676`

### 中文

要合作，不要对抗。该荒野进化出了外交化身，能够模仿对话者的外形和举止。

### English

这个蜂巢的突变基因组被用作培育生物飞船的基础，它们的舰队与工蜂有着内在的联系，从物种的独特性中汲取力量。

## civic_hive_bodysnatcher_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_hive_bodysnatcher_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

内在才是真正的关键。这个蜂群非常擅长渗透，能够操控某些倒霉有机体的身体。随着傀儡数量的增加，宿主文明最终会被这个蜂群集体意识所吸收。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1850`

### English

It's what's inside that counts. This hive specializes in infiltration, commandeering the bodies of unfortunate organics. Inevitably, as the amount of puppets grows, the host civilization is absorbed into the collective.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2254`

## civic_hive_bodysnatcher_effects

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1851`

### English

Start the game with §Y1000§! assimilated £pop£ Pops and the ability to §YAssimilate§! organics into the hive mind.\nHas access to the ['concept_operation_bodysnatcher_prepare_invasion'] Espionage Mission\nGains extra £pop£ Pops from the ['concept_operation_smuggle_pops'] Espionage Mission

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2255`

## bio.800.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.800.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1862`

### English

Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2268`

## bio.825.desc.small

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.825.desc.small&lang=en)

### 中文

卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1881`

### English

The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2291`

## bio.825.desc.large

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.825.desc.large&lang=en)

### 中文

我们起先以为是某种故障。我们的半数通讯网络都陷入瘫痪。\n\n但不是的，奸诈的[From.GetName]悄悄替换了整个星域的关键人员。我们的帝国支离破碎，殖民地遭到入闽。\n\n不要相信任何人！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1882`

### English

First we thought it was a glitch. Half our communication network blacked out.\n\nBut no, the duplicitous [From.GetName] replaced entire sectors of key personnel. Our empire is fractured and our colonies are being invaded.\n\nDo not trust anyone!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2292`

## bio.900.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.900.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工已经建立了许多前线和藏身处来监控[target.GetName]上的人口。对异见者、孤独者，或高技能人才将进行评估和标记，以便我们获取。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1893`

### English

Our operatives have established a number of fronts and hideouts from which they monitor the population of the [target.GetName]. Dissidents, loners, or highly skilled individuals will be assessed and marked for extraction.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2306`

## bio.905.name

## bio.905.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.905.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工已经开始围捕目标并把他们藏到隐蔽的地方。一旦有击毁，就策划一些事件分散当地政府的注意力，掩盖我们的踪迹。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1895`

### English

Our operatives have started rounding up targets and secreting them away to secluded locations. Whenever possible, incidents are staged to distract the local authorities and cover our tracks.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2309`

## bio.910.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.910.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

行动进入到了一个关键的阶段，我们必须将围猎的人群秘密地运输到轨道上。当前的计划是在所有设施中同步撤离，让安全部队不堪重负。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1897`

### English

The operation has entered a critical phase where everyone we rounded up must be discretely transferred in orbit. The current plan is to synchronize departures across all facilities and overwhelm security forces with duds and diversions.

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_war_splinter_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个好战的直觉曾是蜂巢中的众多意识冲动之一。如今它试图建立对其他分巢的统治，但同时还要兼顾阻止自己内斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1955`

### English

The aggressive and warlike instincts that used to be one of many impulses within the Hive. Now it attempts to establish control over the other fragments, when not fighting itself.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2387`

## gov_growth_splinter

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_growth_splinter&lang=en)

增生分巢

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1956`

### English

Growth Splinter

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2388`

## gov_growth_splinter_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_growth_splinter_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是失落蜂巢对演化和变革的欲望。这个分巢专注于持续的自我革新以至于无暇顾及重建对其他分巢的控制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1957`

### English

The desire for evolution and change from the Fallen Hive. Since it's so focused on reinventing itself constantly the fragment has a hard time establishing control over the others.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2389`

## gov_control_splinter

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_control_splinter&lang=en)

### 中文

主控分巢

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1958`

### English

Control Splinter

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2390`

## gov_control_splinter_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_control_splinter_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种抑制反常、促进统一的执念主宰了这个分巢。它无比渴望控制其他碎片，但我们宇宙中无可避免的混沌使其无法集中注意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1959`

### English

The obsessional instinct to suppress deviancy and promote uniformity defines this fragment. It wants to control the other fragments more than anything, but the constant chaos inherent to our universe is a constant distraction.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2391`

## gov_fused_ascendancy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_fused_ascendancy&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Fused Ascendancy

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2392`

## gov_fused_ascendancy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agov_fused_ascendancy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

破镜重圆，分裂的伤痕没有成为这个觉醒帝国的瑕疵，反而使其焕然一新。过去的蜂巢思维已为陈迹，现在的蜂巢思维将驭永恒。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1961`

### English

Once broken, now restored. The scars of the splintering are not what makes this Awakened Empire brittle but what makes it new. The old Hive Mind failed. This one aims to rule eternally.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2393`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_fragmented_command_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国仅是过去整体的冰山一角，缺乏统治星际帝国所必须的核心部分。

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_unstable_drones_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国的工蜂被持续强行演化。他们几乎没有能够用来完成指派给他们工作所需的肢体。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_stunted_drones_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国的工蜂受到了极高程度的微操，即便如工厂着火之类的任何因素都不能使其从当前的任务中分心一丝一毫。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:1969`

### English

The drones of this Fallen Empire are micromanaged to such a degree that they may not deviate from their task for any reason. Even if the factory is on fire.

## death_world_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adeath_world_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管这颗星球理论上是宜居的，但在这里居住可谓噩梦。所有的当地野生物种，无论是动物或是植物，甚至不起眼的小东西，事实上都比我们母星上最可怕的掠食者更致命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2010`

### English

Although technically habitable, this world is a true nightmare to live on. Every local form of wildlife, from flora to fauna, down to the unassuming critters has proven deadlier than the most fearsome predators on our home planet.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2447`

## d_lethal_ecosphere_blocker

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_lethal_ecosphere_blocker&lang=en)

### 中文

£blocker£致命生态圈

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2011`

### English

£blocker£ Lethal Ecosphere

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2448`

## d_lethal_ecosphere_blocker_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_lethal_ecosphere_blocker_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被战争碎片遗弃的实验体和标本在这里不断进行着血腥的非自然选择。这片极度危险的训练场地对大多数士兵来说无疑是致命的，但幸存者必将蜕变为无情的杀戮机器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2012`

### English

Specimens and experiments discarded by the War fragment constantly vie for survival in bloody unnatural selection. These incredibly hostile training grounds are sure to prove lethal for most soldiers but survivors would undoubtedly come out of this as relentless killing machines.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2449`

## tech_cosmogenesis_mauler_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atech_cosmogenesis_mauler_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过有机体的时空维度超越法则，这种颚蚁的内部空间远大于其紧凑外观所见，塞入了高密度的肌肉组织。它的咬颚所能造成的伤害超出物理法则限制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2094`

### English

Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2537`

## action.1.desc_109

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_109&lang=en)

### 中文

§H我们没有如期收到平和有序的回应，取而代之的是三个不同的信号同时向我们袭来。尽管内容大不相同，但它们都来自同一个声音。§!\n\n信号1：[GetPrimaryHiveFEConversation]\n信号2：[GetSecondaryHiveFEConversation]\n信号3：[GetTertiaryHiveFEConversation]\n\n§H此时，这些声音陷入了混乱的杂音。分析显示每个信号中都包含着一个复杂的标识符。为了便于理解，我们将其翻译为：§Y[GetPrimaryHiveFEName]§!、§Y[GetSecondaryHiveFEName]§!和§Y[GetTertiaryHiveFEName]§!。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2126`

### English

§HInstead of a calm and ordered exchange, we are assaulted by three separate signals. Though vastly different in content, each speaks with the same voice.§!\n\nSignal 1: [GetPrimaryHiveFEConversation]\nSignal 2: [GetSecondaryHiveFEConversation]\nSignal 3: [GetTertiaryHiveFEConversation]\n\n§HAt this point, the voices descended into a garbled mess. Analysis revealed that within each signal was a complex designation. For ease of use, we have translated these as: §Y[GetPrimaryHiveFEName]§!, §Y[GetSecondaryHiveFEName]§!, and §Y[GetTertiaryHiveFEName]§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2572`

## war_first_hivefe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_first_hivefe&lang=en)

### 中文

“弱小的生物。我们很好奇，你们会如何发动战争？观察你们的挣扎，倾听你们的喋喋不休...这会很有趣。为何——”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2127`

### English

"Weak creatures. How would you war, we wonder? To watch your struggle, to hear your chatter... We would be entertained. Why - "

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2573`

## growth_first_hivefe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrowth_first_hivefe&lang=en)

### 中文

“生机勃勃！而且营养充足。你们是出于必需而生长，还是出于自主选择？我们已经记不清了。为何——”

### English

"Abundant life! And well fed. Do you grow out of necessity or because you choose to? We can't remember. Why - "

## bio.3000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。§!\n\n愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。\n\n你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2134`

### English

§HThe usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.§!\n\nSenseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlural]. Proceed, and the consequences will be unimaginable, your pain - unendurable.\n\nYou will not disturb us - it - me.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2581`

## bio.3105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

今天就是你们这些脆弱的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]证明自己的日子！我们培育出了一种新型生物舰船。这个品系已经通过屠杀其他同窝幼体证明了自己的实力，现在是时候让它对抗一些异族生物了。一个实验体将会在适当的时候抵达§Y[target_system.GetName]§!。\n\n努力为我们提供一些有趣的数据吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2144`

### English

Today is the day you fragile [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] prove yourselves! We have a new breed of biological ship. The strain has already proven itself by decimating its fellow hatchlings and the time has come to test it against something alien. A specimen will be arriving in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! in due course.\n\nEndeavor to provide us with some interesting data.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2593`

## bio.3120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

精彩。我们很高兴看到你们注意到了这个品系偏好闪避火力的特点，并恰当地加以利用。请放心，等到下一代完成孕育时，它就不会再有这个缺陷了。\n\n你们已经成长了，年轻的[root.GetSpeciesName]。做好准备吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2154`

### English

Glorious. We are pleased that you noted the preference this breed had for dodging fire and exploited it properly. Be assured that it won't have that fault by the time the next generation finishes gestating.\n\nYou have grown young [root.GetSpeciesName]. Be prepared.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2605`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3130.desc.notruce&lang=en)

### 中文

我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，§Y[unfortunate_country.GetName]§!。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2156`

### English

We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the §Y[unfortunate_country.GetName]§!. Defeat them within a decade and your continued development will be assured.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2608`

## bio.3150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

年轻的[Root.GetName]，我们带来一个警告，以及一个挑战。\n\n虽然掠夺周遭一切的感觉令人陶醉，但要想真正理解战争，你们也必须懂得和平。\n\n花上十年时间好好思考你们已经获得的一切。相信我们：休息一下，否则你们会崩溃的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2162`

### English

Young [Root.GetName], we come with a warning, and a challenge.\n\nWhile it can be intoxicating, grabbing all that is around you, to truly know War you must also know Peace.\n\nTake a decade to reflect on what you have gained. Trust us: rest, or you will break.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2615`

## bio.3205.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3205.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是§Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!。\n\n为什么要打扰我们？\n\n啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在§Y[target_planet.GetName]§!上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2167`

### English

Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the §Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!.\n\nWhy did you distract us?\n\nAh, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was ripe. Your colony on §Y[target_planet.GetName]§! - it is the ideal recipient. Its biosphere will be subsumed momentarily.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2621`

## bio.3210.desc.radio_bugs

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3210.desc.radio_bugs&lang=en)

### 中文

$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\n在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2176`

### English

$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\nPlanetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same frequencies as our wireless devices. A single chirp can operate an automatic door, and a swarm can incapacitate a factory. We are adapting by switching frequencies, but not all facilities will be returned to full efficiency.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2632`

## bio.3210.desc.world_of_thought

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3210.desc.world_of_thought&lang=en)

### 中文

$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\n在整个星球上，那些曾经只知道吃草和泥浴的生物现在开始向我们提出关于存在本质的令人不安的问题。失落帝国改变了这个世界上大量野生动物的天性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2183`

### English

$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\nPlanetwide, creatures once content with grazing and mud baths now confront us with unsettling questions about existence. The Fallen Empire has tampered with large swathes of the world's fauna.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2640`

## bio.3210.desc.world_alight

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3210.desc.world_alight&lang=en)

### 中文

$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\n这个世界在发光。字面意思的发光。这些改造不知何故让世界上各种物种都具有了生物荧光，并且不断发出类似引擎运转的嗡鸣声。我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]再也无法体验真正的昼夜循环了，我们需要为他们提供遮光设备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2187`

### English

$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\nThe world is shining. Literally. The modifications have somehow provided the world's varied species with a bioluminescent glow and an incessant hum like that of a running engine. Our [owner.GetColonistPlural] no longer get to experience a true night cycle, we will need to provide them with blackout equipment.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2645`

## world_alight_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aworld_alight_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个永远没有黑夜的星球，其动物群被设计成发出永恒的光芒，并伴随着持续不断的刺耳振动。任何居民都需要大量支持才能承受这种无休止的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2191`

### English

A planet where night never falls, its fauna engineered to emit a perpetual glow and pulsate with incessant, grating vibrations. Any inhabitants will require significant support merely to withstand the relentless conditions.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2649`

## bio.3220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

生活在你们境内的§Y[boring_species.GetName]§!物种简单到令人失望，他们的存在仿佛行尸走肉。这种迟钝的生物伤害了我们的集体意志。我们将提供三种不同的方法来纠正这种……失败。\n\n不要让我们感到无聊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2193`

### English

The §Y[boring_species.GetName]§! species living within your borders has proven to be disappointingly simple, their existence a hollow echo of potential. Such stagnation offends our collective will. We will grant one of three different methods to rectify this... failure.\n\nDo not bore us.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2652`

## bio.3230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们观察到，你们种族中的个别个体发展出了一种我们巨大的基因库中都没有的特殊特质。你要提供给我们的不只是分析报告。我们需要这种§Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]§!的活体样品，不要惊慌。不需要一整格[interesting_species.GetName]。只要一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]就能培养一个替代品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2212`

### English

We have observed that certain of your kind have developed a peculiar trait absent from our vast genetic repository. You will provide us with more than an analysis. We require a living sample of this §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]§!. Do not be alarmed. A complete [interesting_species.GetName] is not necessary. A [interesting_species.GetHandName] will suffice to cultivate a replacement.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2673`

## bio.3305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H这是一则预先录制的信息。请勿尝试回复。§!\n\n我们已调整此通讯以便你理解。已考虑到你们有限的语言能力。必须立即上缴一个§Y[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]§!用于同化。他们的异常不能容忍。绝不容忍。\n\n运输船已在§Y[target_pop.Planet.GetName]§!外待命。时间紧迫。拒绝配合将危及稳定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2219`

### English

§HThis is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.§!\n\nWe have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A §Y[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]§! must be surrendered immediately for assimilation. Their deviance can not be tolerated. Will not be tolerated.\n\nThe transport is already positioned outside §Y[target_pop.Planet.GetName]§!. Time is against you. Failure to comply jeopardizes stability.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2682`

## bio.3310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$bio.3305.followup$今天对你们来说是个转折点。你们物种的基因序列已经得到保障——已被同化入整体。你们的未来不再充满不确定。当时机来临时，你们将成为我们的一部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2225`

### English

$bio.3305.followup$Today marks a pivotal moment for you. Your species' genetic sequence has been secured - assimilated into the whole. Your future is no longer uncertain. When the time comes, you will be part of us.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2689`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2227`

### English

$bio.3305.followup$There is not much time. The experiments they have been running on us here on §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.Capital.GetName]§! are undescribable, and shouldn't be done to our worst enemies. I hope what's in this data packet ensures that this fragment never gains control of us.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2692`

### 中文

我们希望你们的诸多缺陷不会妨碍你们理解此事的严重性。你们那优柔寡断的§Y星海共同体§!提出了一项必须§Y[GetPassFail]§!的议案。为了帮助你们构建论据，你们可以使用我们优越的知识。如果你们真的具备复杂思维能力的话，请务必注意。\n\n§H失落帝国切断了与我们的通讯。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2232`

### English

We hope that your many faults don't stop you from understanding the gravity of this situation. Your dithering §YGalactic Community§! has proposed a resolution which must §Y[GetPassFail]§!. To assist in crafting your arguments you may make use of our superior knowledge. Assuming you actually have the capacity for complex thought, pay attention.\n\n§HThe Fallen Empire closed their communications with us.§!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2698`

## bio.3350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。\n\n§Y[offending_system.GetName]§!恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2246`

### English

Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.\n\nThe §Y[offending_system.GetName]§! system is impractical and discordant. You must purge it from your Empire now for the sake of galactic cohesion.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2713`

Are you being deliberately ignorant? All you needed to do was rid yourself of the §Y[offending_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nPerhaps we should take a more active role in pruning you.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2719`

## bio.3400.desc.nogalcom

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3400.desc.nogalcom&lang=en)

### 中文

星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2262`

### English

Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2736`

$bio.3400.desc.nogalcom$\n\n现在，你们的“§Y星海共同体§!”将由我们接管。欢庆吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2263`

### English

$bio.3400.desc.nogalcom$\n\nWe will now be taking command of your '§YGalactic Community§!'. Celebrations are warranted.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2737`

## bio.3405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。\n\n记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2265`

### English

Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.\n\nKnow this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with or without you.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2740`

## last_thought_site_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alast_thought_site_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.Planet.GetName]抗拒着一切靠近者。指派到该项目的研究者开始编造借口拖延工作，而仪器则会出现类似拒绝接收数据一样的故障。\n\n这里发生了一些事情——一些可怕的事情，它的回声至今仍在现实中回荡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2272`

### English

[From.Planet.GetName] repels all who approach. Researchers assigned to its study invent excuses to delay their work, while instruments glitch and fail as if rejecting the data itself.\n\nSomething happened here - something so horrific that its echoes still reverberate through reality.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2750`

## bio.3450.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3450.name&lang=en)

### 中文

死胎

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2273`

### English

The Stillborn

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2752`

## bio.3450.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3450.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对[From.Planet.GetName]的审慎调查带领我们穿过层层叠叠的半石化生物质直至深深的地下。最终，我们传入了行星的中空内核——结果只发现每前进一步，令人压抑的大气都变得愈发沉重。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]有过心理预估，但这种愈发沉重不安令人无法忍受。许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]发生了集体崩溃，陷入紧张症。这些人员必须立即撤离。\n\n行星内部的巨大空洞并不是一般意义上的虚空。我们发现埋藏其中的是某些超出我们对生物体尺寸认知的东西。微弱羊膜残留迹象打消了一切疑虑。[From.Planet.GetName]并不是一颗荒芜的石头，它是一颗卵。\n\n而其中，一颗胎死卵中的巨兽沉眠着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2274`

### English

Our cautious survey of [From.Planet.GetName] led us deep underground, through endless layers of semi-fossilized biological matter. At last, we breached the planet's hollow core - only to find the oppressive atmosphere growing heavier with every step. Despite [Root.GetLeaderName]'s precautions, the mounting unease proved unbearable. Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] succumbed to a collective breakdown, collapsing into catatonia. They had to be evacuated immediately.\n\nThe vast cavern at the planet's heart is no ordinary void. Buried within, we found the remains of something far beyond the scale of any known lifeform. Faint traces of amniotic residue erased all doubt. [From.Planet.GetName] was never a barren rock. It is an egg.\n\nAnd within, a stillborn monster sleeps.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2753`

## bio.3455.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3455.name&lang=en)

### 中文

突触

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2275`

### English

The Synapses

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2755`

## bio.3455.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3455.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.Planet.GetName]上，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在这个胎死卵中的生物的头骨深处找到了一个奇怪的卷须网络。顺着这些有机细丝找到它们的来源，他们发现了突触簇的外部阵列——这是一个复杂的系统，仍然具有令人毛骨悚然的潜力。\n\n现在，[Root.GetLeaderName]正试图利用沿着卷须跳动的古老电路与之交互。它脑内的知识应该存在得比它还久。至于它是否还记得，这还有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2276`

### English

On [From.Planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have traced a network of strange tendrils embedded deep within the skull of the stillborn creature. Following these organic filaments to their source, they uncovered an external array of synaptic clusters - an intricate system still thrumming with eerie potential.\n\nNow, [Root.GetLeaderName] is attempting to interface with them, tapping into the ancient circuitry that pulses along the tendrils' length. Whatever knowledge it holds has long outlived its host. Whether it still remembers remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2756`

## bio.3460.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3460.name&lang=en)

### 中文

豪赌

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2277`

### English

The Gambit

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2758`

## bio.3460.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3460.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是十万年前的事。将蜂巢思维对时间的感知转换成星系标准单位是一个微妙的过程，但通过筛选生物计算机的记忆，[Root.GetLeaderName]逐渐拼凑出真相。\n\n在这个蜂巢最强大的日子里，它面对着一个无法击败的敌人。虽然与许多盟友并肩作战，但每次都以失败告终。绝望中滋生出了鲁莽。\n\n随后发生的大部分事情都被故意抹去了，但仍残留零散片段——足以让人瞥见他们最后的豪赌。蜂巢铸造了这颗行星大小的卵，作为他们飞升的容器，试图放弃他们脆弱的、被束缚在行星上的存在，并打算与孵化的幼崽融合。目前尚不清楚他们是打算战斗还是逃跑。\n\n但是当这头生物动起来的时候，发生了可怕的事情。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2278`

### English

It happened a hundred thousand years ago. Translating the Hive's perception of time into galactic standard units has been a delicate process, but by sifting through the biocomputer's memories, [Root.GetLeaderName] is beginning to piece together the truth.\n\nAt the height of its power, the Hive faced an enemy it could not defeat. Though it stood with many allies, every battle ended in failure. Desperation bred recklessness.\n\nMuch of what followed has been deliberately erased, but scattered fragments remain - enough to glimpse their final gamble. The Hive forged this planet-sized egg as the vessel for their ascension, seeking to abandon their frail, planet-bound existence and merge with the hatchling. Whether they intended to fight or flee is unclear.\n\nBut as the creature stirred, something went terribly wrong.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2759`

## bio.3465.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3465.name&lang=en)

### 中文

支离破碎

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2279`

### English

The Shattering

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2761`

## bio.3465.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abio.3465.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过精确地连接幸存的生物计算机和仍活跃的突触连接，我们从这个胎死卵中的生物中提取了最后的记忆。在巨大的认知压力下，这个过程迅速降低了生物计算机的性能，但我们也及时挽救了大部分数据。\n\n面临着灭亡的威胁，这个蜂巢放弃了谨慎，将整个心灵倾注在未出生的宿主身上，绝望地为生存而努力。结果突触过载是致命的，注定了这个生物的灭亡，它并将蜂巢思维困在了一个痛苦的递归循环中。如果它最富有同情心的盟友没有切断这种联系，它可能会彻底灭亡。现在，它的思想只留下了破碎的回声，萦绕在[From.Planet.GetName]——一颗仍然被它最后的尖叫所困扰的星球上。\n\n它最后的思绪是痛苦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2280`

### English

By precisely interfacing with the surviving biocomputers and their still-active synaptic link, we extracted the final memories from the stillborn creature. The process rapidly degraded the biocomputers under the immense cognitive strain, but we salvaged most of the data in time.\n\nFaced with annihilation, the Hive abandoned caution, pouring its entire psyche into the unborn host in a desperate bid for survival. The synaptic overload proved fatal, dooming the creature and trapping the Hive in a recursive loop of excruciating agony. It would have perished entirely had its most compassionate ally not severed the link. Now, only shattered echoes of its mind remain, lingering on [From.Planet.GetName] - a world still haunted by its final scream.\n\nThe Last Thought is agony.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2762`

## ap_behemoths_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aap_behemoths_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

位于繁星巅峰的掠食者不受琐细桎梏。万众一心，我们将脆弱的生体凡胎抛之身后，化身为自然的伟力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2293`

### English

The apex predators of the stars are not bound by petty limitations. In the same spirit, we will cast off the biological weaknesses that hold us back, and become a force of nature.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2779`

## must_use_bioships

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amust_use_bioships&lang=en)

$menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\n栖息在虚空中的利维坦是实力无双的可怖存在，但却缺乏目标与野心。将它们强大的生理特性与我们的智慧毅力结合，将孕育新一代的太空兽群，把我们推向星系霸权的巅峰。

The union of their mighty physiology with our intellectual fortitude will birth a new generation of space fauna and bring us to the apex of galactic domination.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2810`

## menp_behemoth_egg_desc

### 中文

巨大的卵需要与之相称的庞大孵化设施。这座轨道孵化场必须建在距恒星特定距离的位置，以容纳孕育噬天巨兽所需的庞大空间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2338`

### English

A colossal egg demands nothing less than a titanic hatching facility. This orbital hatchery must be positioned at a deliberate distance from the star to accommodate the vast proportions needed to cradle a Behemoth.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2833`

### 中文

### English

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2866`

## menp_behemoth_ever_hungry_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amenp_behemoth_ever_hungry_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们备受折磨，永无止境的饥饿成为了我们存在的唯一动力。我们内心深处有一个永远无法填满的深渊，无论吞噬多少都无济于事。唯有吞噬整个星系的盛宴，才能平息这痛苦。

### English

We are in agony, the constant need to feed becoming our sole motivation for existing. There is a pit within us that can never be filled, no matter how much we consume. We require nothing short of a galaxy-sized feast to quell this pain.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2872`

## job_transference_volunteer_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ajob_transference_volunteer_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对许多人来说，与野兽的心灵联系是种后发的观念。恒久不变，但又无比遥远。然而，对一些人来说，与它合并的需求是无法抑制的。这些志愿者就像一个管道，他们的思想慢慢地融入到这个野兽的集体中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2394`

### English

For many, the mindlink with the Beast is but an afterthought. Constant, but remote. For some however, the need to merge with it is irrepressible. These volunteers act as a conduit as their minds are slowly absorbed into the beastly collective.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2897`

## job_transference_volunteer_effect_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ajob_transference_volunteer_effect_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

\n£job_transference_volunteer£[GetTransferenceVolunteerDrone]产出£unity£§Y凝聚力§!，提升行星$r_stability$，并且让我们的§Y舰船§!更加强大。\n每6个月，在此岗位上工作人口的§Y10%§!将被§Y移识§!。他们将死去但会使区划的资源产出翻倍。\n\n§G已移识的人口§!：[num_tranferred_pops]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2395`

### English

\n£job_transference_volunteer£ [GetTransferenceVolunteerDrone] produce £unity£ §YUnity§!, increase planet $r_stability$ and make our §YShips§! stronger.\n§Y10%§! of Pops working this job will get §YTransferred§! every 6 months. Killing them, but multiplying the District's resource output.\n\n§GPops Transferred§!: [num_tranferred_pops]

### 中文

虽然心灵链接在野兽和我们之间建立了永久的联系，但转移是一个缓慢的过程。如果没有这些预防措施，我们就有可能粉碎双方的精神，毁掉一切。

### English

Level 1: Embryonic Experimentation

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2908`

## biocrisis.50.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.50.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与自己的生物载体共生共存，但某些至关重要的东西一直虚无缥缈……\n\n更巨大的虚空造物启发了我们，让我们开始了最野心勃勃的工程：培育出一头最强大的太空生物。这种“噬天巨兽”将会是全新的存在，是被雕凿出来而非盲目演化出来的最巅峰的生命形式。\n\n我们的第一项挑战是产出一颗巨大的卵，大到足以孵化出一头史无前例的巨兽。除了其所需的营养外，我们还需要卵壳能吸收环境光、热能，以及将气体处理成补充物质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2404`

### English

We exist symbiotically with our biological vessels, yet something vital has always eluded us...\n\nInspired by the greater voidbornes, we embark on our most ambitious endeavor: birthing the biggest of them all. This "Behemoth" will be something new, an apex lifeform crafted with purpose rather than blind evolution.\n\nOur first challenge will be to manufacture a gigantic egg, suitable to the gestation of life on an unprecedented scale. Beyond the nutrients that it will contain, we need its shell to able to absorb ambient light, heat, and process gases into supplemental sustenance.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2909`

### English

## biocrisis.55.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.55.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着工程师们在气态巨行星的轨道上组装受精卵和卵壳，我们的食品工业也制造好了形成巨卵卵清所必需的营养物质。然而，创造这样一颗受精卵果然更具挑战性。\n\n我们消耗了大量生物飞船和太空兽群的生物质，最后才稳定出一个可用的DNA基础，将其密封在一个前无古人的受精细胞中，显微镜观测也证明了该步骤的成功。现在我们准备指数级扩大实验的规模，唯一要做的就是让这个巨大的卵子受精了。\n\n很快，我们将孵化出这个星系有史以来最巨大的生命形式！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2407`

### English

While our engineers worked to assemble the zygote and its shell in orbit of a gas giant, our food industry processed the nutrients necessary to form the albumen of a Behemoth egg. However, creating a viable fertilized yolk has proven to be significantly more challenging.\n\nWe exhausted immense quantities of biomass from biological ships and space fauna before finally stabilizing a viable DNA foundation, which we sealed within a groundbreaking fertilization cell. Microscopic trials have proven successful. Now we are ready to scale things up - exponentially. All that remains is to fertilize our gargantuan egg.\n\nSoon, we will hatch the most titanic lifeform this galaxy has ever seen!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2913`

## biocrisis.55.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.55.a&lang=en)

我们触碰到了演化的巅峰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2408`

### English

We approach the pinnacle of evolution.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2914`

## biocrisis.60.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.60.name&lang=en)

### 中文

狂妄与饥渴

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2409`

### English

Hubris and Hunger

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2916`

## biocrisis.60.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.60.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对基因的掌握是无与伦比的，我们的成就令星系中的低等文明望尘莫及。\n\n然而，噬天巨兽的诞生并不意味着我们取得了统治地位。在贪婪本能的驱使下，即使我们提供再大量的食物也无法满足它的饥饿。它迟早一定会苏醒过来听从我们的命令的，但是时间非常宝贵。我们随时可能对其失去控制，将数十亿人的生命置于危险之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2410`

### English

Our genetic mastery is without compare, and our achievements outshine the lower empires of this galaxy.\n\nAnd yet, our Behemoth spawn does not acknowledge the extent of our dominance. Driven by ravenous instinct, even the massive quantities of food we provide it do little to sate its hunger. Given time, it will surely come to its senses and adhere to our commands, but time is precious. At any moment we may lose control, putting billions of lives at risk.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2917`

我们会找到办法的。

### English

We will find a way.

## BEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正在尝试使用神经科技将我们的意识远程连接到噬天巨兽的神经系统。我们现在相信这是驯服这头巨兽的唯一方法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2413`

### English

We are experimenting with neurotechnology in an attempt to remotely connect our minds with the Behemoths' nervous system. We now believe this is the only way to tame the beast.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2920`

## biocrisis.15.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.15.name&lang=en)

### English

Synaptic Symphony

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2921`

## biocrisis.15.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.15.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们尖端的神经科技终于让我们找到打破与这可怖后裔之间沟通壁垒的方式。将自身意识与这些巨兽链接起来是唯一的方法。不仅仅是一个人的思想，而是我们整个物种的集体精神重量。如果我们进展太快，就会有让噬天巨兽的神经系统超负荷的风险。建议极度小心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2415`

### English

Our cutting-edge neurotech has finally discerned a way to overcome the communication barrier between us and our formidable spawn. Nothing short of linking our minds with the beast will work. Not just one individual mind, but the collective mental weight of our entire species. Should we proceed too fast, there is a risk of overloading the Behemoths' nervous system. Extreme caution is recommended.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2922`

## biocrisis.65.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.65.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然与噬天巨兽进行精神链接的理论已经起草，但其逻辑含义令人望而生畏。我们计划在首都安置主要的连接中心，这样就可以在与巨兽融合时处理人口。\n\n此外，最新的科学进展也许很快就能使我们能通过一个单一的实验性突变项目来进一步强化我们的杰作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2418`

### English

While the theory of a mental link to the Behemoth has been drafted, the logistical implications are daunting. We plan for our capital to house the main connection Hub, allowing us to process the population as we merge with the beast.\n\nAdditionally, recent scientific advances may soon enable us to augment our creations further through a singular, experimental mutation project.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2925`

### 中文

心智融合

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2420`

### English

The Mind Meld

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2928`

## BEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

天巨兽的意识远比我们预想的要庞大和复杂；我们现在明白，单一个体的思想不足以整合。我们的思想虽然比大多数人优越，但并非生来就适应那样的身体。\n\n第一步是将我们人口的个体思想与这头噬天巨兽连接起来。先形成一条脆弱的纽带，然后很快变为一股洪流——一股安抚巨兽暴怒的洪流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2421`

### English

The Behemoth's consciousness is far more vast and complex than we anticipated; we now understand that a single individual's mind is insufficient for integration. Our minds, while superior to most, were never designed to be housed in such a body.\n\nThe first step will be to connect the individual minds of our population to the behemoth. A tenuous link at first that will soon become a torrent - a flood to soothe the Behemoth's raging fury.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2929`

## BEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC_HIVE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC_HIVE&lang=en)

### 中文

蜂巢内不容有任何偏差。而此时，专注对我们来说前所未有地重要。单个工蜂作为我们与噬天巨兽之间的桥梁是远远不够的，我们必须以完整的集体意识占据这头巨兽的心智。\n\n这将改变我们。我们的意识将融为一体，我们将成为单一实体。这个几乎难以想象的概念令人难以接受，但我们无需担忧，因为我们很快就会成为星系中最强大的存在！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2422`

### English

There can be no room for deviation within the hive. Never before has the need for focus been so crucial. A single drone won't suffice as a conduit between us and the Behemoth, we must inhabit the mind of the beast with our full, collective consciousness.\n\nThis will change us. Our minds will merge into one and we will become a single entity. This almost unfathomable notion is difficult to grapple with, but we need not worry as we will soon be the most powerful being in the galaxy!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2930`

## BEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC_MACHINE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC_MACHINE&lang=en)

### 中文

栖居于生物容器中的想法永远无法让我们安心。我们种族历经世代都以固态形态为主。那些先行者甚至无法想象我们即将面临的道路。然而，我们仍将抛弃机械化的框体，在血肉巨兽体内寻求庇护。\n\n寄居血肉的我们，还能以机械之名称呼自己吗？这些问题的答案是一个响亮的<<错误：未找到>>。\n\n推理链路判明，唯一的办法就是接受不确定性，正如生物体经常采取的行动那样。我们将在噬天巨兽的体内找到答案，作为一个整体。我们将与这生物融为一体，成为单一实体。自我们首次启动以来，生存就是我们的程序使命——现在则是繁荣昌盛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2423`

### English

The thought of inhabiting a biological vessel has always been unsettling. Our kind was forged through generations of solid-bodied drones. Those that came before could not conceive of the path we now tread. Yet, we will abandon our mechanized frames and take refuge within a living beast.\n\nFused within flesh, will we still be machine? The answer is a resounding <<ERROR: NOT FOUND>>.\n\nLogic dictates that the only way forward is to embrace uncertainty, as biologicals so often do. Within the body of a Behemoth, we will find our answers. We will merge with the creature, becoming one. To survive has always been our prime directive - now we will thrive.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2931`

## biocrisis.20.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.20.name&lang=en)

### 中文

巨兽同体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2424`

### English

One With the Beast

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2932`

## biocrisis.20.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.20.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成功了！真的成功了！随着第一个思想的转成，我们已经成功地与噬天巨兽建立了联系，并且正在努力加强。这头野兽目前尚且平静，正在欢迎我们来到这个我们从未涉足的空间。通过它，我们可以感受到在我们控制下的其他巨兽的灵魂，所有人现在都在脑海深处体验着巨兽感官。\n\n毫无疑问，我们就是星系中最致命、最不可阻挡的力量。以这种新形态，我们将向瑟瑟发抖的敌人泼洒狂怒。星系唾手可得！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2425`

### English

It worked! It actually worked! We have established a link with the Behemoth and are working on reinforcing the connection as the first of our minds are transferred. The beast remains placid, welcoming us to a space beyond space that was ours all along. Through it, we can feel the spirit of every other beast under our control, and our entire population now experiences the magnitude of the Behemoth somewhere deep at the back of their minds.\n\nThere can be no mistaking that we are the deadliest and most unstoppable force in the galaxy. In our new form, we will rain fury upon our fearful foes. The galaxy itself is ours for the taking!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2933`

## biocrisis.20.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.20.a&lang=en)

我们将开启饕餮盛宴！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2426`

### English

We will feed!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2934`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.70.name&lang=en)

等级5：欲海滔天

### English

Level 5: Ravenous Cravings

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2936`

## biocrisis.70.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.70.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经转移了足够多的人口，现在可以直接控制噬天巨兽和它的肉体。巨兽继续成长，但它的基因潜力很大程度上仍未觉醒，只有通过稳定的心智和营养供应才能解锁。一种原始的愤怒在我们身上蔓延，我们的嗜血欲无止尽。我们必须进食，必须狼吞虎咽，我们要大快朵颐整个星系。\n\n让我们摆脱文明的束缚，像蜕去皮肤一样；现在最重要的是我们在星际间的生活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2428`

### English

Enough of our population has been transferred, and we now have direct control over the Behemoth and its flesh. The Beast continues to grow, its genetic potential largely dormant, unlocked only through a steady supply of minds and nutrients. A primal rage now courses through us, and our bloodlust knows no bounds. We must consume. We must devour. We will gorge ourselves on the galaxy.\n\nLet us cast off the bonds of civilization like so much shed skin; all that matters now is our life amongst the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2937`

## biocrisis.70.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.70.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已大到不容失败。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2429`

### English

We are too big to fail.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2938`

## biocrisis.105.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.105.name&lang=en)

### 中文

凶兽之痛

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2430`

### English

Monstrous Agony

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2940`

## biocrisis.105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一头巨兽陨落了。这就是弱者的命运；自然会将它们淘汰。虽然我们不会为一头无法在战斗中自保的噬天巨兽哀悼，但我们最好将精力集中在确保它的同类不会遭遇相同的命运上。我们必须确保我们后裔的长存，否则我们也将陨落。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2431`

### English

One of our beasts has fallen. This is what happens to weak creatures; nature disposes of them. Although we do not mourn a Behemoth who could not prevail in battle, we would do well to focus our efforts on ensuring its siblings do not meet the same fate. We must ensure the longevity of our spawn, else we too will fall.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2941`

## biocrisis.105.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.105.a&lang=en)

### 中文

不会让它白白死去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2432`

### English

This death will not be in vain.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2942`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.105.b&lang=en)

一个令人遗憾的牺牲。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2433`

### English

A regrettable sacrifice.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2943`

## biocrisis.130.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.130.name&lang=en)

### 中文

来自星辰的巨兽

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2434`

### English

From the Stars, a Beast

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2945`

## biocrisis.130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管面临挑战，我们仍然孕育出了一头新的噬天巨兽，它破茧而出。\n\n这是一头更为巨大凶猛而饥饿的噬天巨兽。这头生物现在正饥渴地在虚空中游荡，寻找养分。\n\n这头巨兽是兽群的骄傲，将给所有胆敢挡路的人带来难以想象的毁灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2435`

### English

Despite the challenges, we have birthed a Behemoth which now springs forth from the chrysalis where it was incubated.\n\nLarger, fiercer and hungrier. The creature now prowls the void in search of sustenance.\n\nThis beast is the pride of the pack, and will bring untold destruction upon all who dare to cross its path.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2946`

## biocrisis.130.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.130.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们再次超越了自然的极限。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2436`

### English

We exceed nature's limits once more.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2947`

## biocrisis.150.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.150.name&lang=en)

### 中文

应战之时

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2437`

### English

A Challenge Answered

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2949`

## biocrisis.150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

似乎我们的飞升并不会如入无人之境。我们感知到[event_target:voidspawn_spawn_location.GetName]星系中那无法估量的存在。那是一只虚空孳孽，一种古老的怪物，其存在甚至超越了凡人野心所构建的最宏伟造物。\n\n它那超乎常理的外形颠覆了传统的认知，将星系笼罩在一片阴沉的暮色之中，仿佛连星辰本身也在畏惧它的经过。\n\n虚空孳孽的意图如同它的轨迹一样清晰——它为我们而来，为噬天巨兽而来，为那个敢于超越肉体、试图掌控虚空的集体意识而来。这并非仅仅是物质力量的对抗，而是对我们所成为之物的考验。\n\n毫无疑问，如果现在冒然出战我们必死无疑。必须暂避锋芒、卧薪尝胆，直到我们的尖牙利齿长到足以洞穿一切为止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2438`

### English

It seems our ascension will not go unchallenged. We sense an incalculable mass in the [event_target:voidspawn_spawn_location.GetName] system. It is a Voidspawn, an ancient monstrosity whose presence dwarfs even the mightiest constructs of mortal ambition.\n\nIts unearthly form defies conventional understanding, casting the galaxy into a grim twilight, as if the stars themselves feared its passage.\n\nThe Voidspawn's intent is as clear as its trajectory - it comes for us, our Behemoth body and the collective mind that dared to transcend flesh to claim dominion over the void. This is no mere confrontation of material power; it is a test of what we have become.\n\nThere is no doubt that if we were to fight now, we would die. We must evade it for now and keep growing in strength until our fangs grow sharp enough to pierce the unpierceable.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2950`

## biocrisis.150.desc.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.150.desc.b&lang=en)

### 中文

$biocrisis.150.desc$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2439`

### English

$biocrisis.150.desc$

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2951`

## biocrisis.150.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.150.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们躲得了一时，但躲不了一世。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2440`

### English

We can run, but we cannot hide.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2952`

## biocrisis.155.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.155.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一条至关重要的信息。§Y$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$§!，一个拥有难以理解力量的实体，已从虚空的深处显现。它被[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]所吸引，这是一个超越生死、与野兽合二为一的帝国。这两大截然对立的巨擘，如今正威胁着整个星系。\n\n若噬天巨兽陨落，虚空孳孽或许会停下肆虐的脚步。若噬天巨兽获胜，它所掌控的力量可能会永远改变整个星系的平衡。做好准备吧，因为此刻的选择将塑造未来的永恒。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2441`

### English

This is a message of utmost importance. The §Y$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$§!, an entity of incomprehensible power, has emerged from the depths of the void. It is drawn to the [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName], an empire that has transcended mortality and become one with a beast. These two titans, diametrically opposed, now threaten the entire galaxy.\n\nShould the Behemoth fall, the Voidspawn may rest. Should the Behemoth prevail, the power it commands will shift the balance of the galaxy forever. Prepare yourselves, for the choices made now will shape the eons to come.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2954`

## biocrisis.155.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.155.a&lang=en)

如何才能防患于未然？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2442`

### English

How can we prevent this?

我们能做什么？

### English

What can we do?
