## biocrisis.156.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.156.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你错了。“防范于未然”是那些“未然”的人才配关心的。我们已经没有这样的余裕了。\n\n巨兽已至。我们古老的秩序在过去经受住了灾难，但坦率地说：我们已经到了最危险的时刻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2446`

### English

You misunderstand. Prevention is the concern of those who still have time. We no longer have such luxury.\n\nThe beast is here. Our ancient order has withstood calamity in the past, but speaking plainly: the situation in which we now find ourselves is critical.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2960`

## biocrisis.157.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.157.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个可以理解的问题。幼稚，但是可以理解。智慧带来接纳。而我们知道没有人会来救我们。\n\n我们的力量太小，能做的太少。你们本可以早点采取行动阻止这一切。如果你们现在没能打败[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]，当星系分崩离析的时候，我们也会尽量不去反对你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2447`

### English

An understandable question. Naive, but understandable. With wisdom comes acceptance. We understand that nobody is coming to save us.\n\nOur order is small so there is little we could have done. You, however, could have acted sooner to stop this. Should you now fail to defeat the [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName], we will try not to hold that against you as the galaxy falls apart.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2961`

## biocrisis.158.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.158.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国往往都有一种追求超出能力范围事物的倾向。特别是[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]，选择了野心而非谨慎，傲慢而不明智。\n\n他们拥有自己无法理解的力量，强迫自己的身体变成自己无法控制的形态。在这过程中，他们很可能就注定了我们所有人的命运。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2448`

### English

Empires have a tendency to reach beyond their means. The [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName] in particular chose ambition over caution, and arrogance over wisdom.\n\nThey wielded powers beyond their comprehension, forced their bodies into forms they could not control. And in doing so, they have likely doomed us all.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2962`

## biocrisis.159.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.159.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

基于你们战斗能力的初步分析，我们觉得你们参战是不会有好结果的。然而逃跑也是徒劳，目前看来，这种局面无可避免。\n\n两头可怖的巨兽摩拳擦掌要在星间大战一番。如果运气好的话，兴许能苟活下去。\n\n如果明智点，就要从这件蠢事中吸取点教训。但要知道，当这场战争结束时，星系都将被改变。我们中是否有人还在这里看到它完全是另一回事了。\n\n……假设，如果你试图拯救星系，杀死噬天巨兽可能会结束虚空孳孽的狩猎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2449`

### English

Based on initial analysis of your combat capabilities, we do not think fighting would end well for you. Assessments of your fleets indicate fleeing would be similarly futile. The present situation is unavoidable.\n\nTwo formidable beasts are squaring up to do battle across the stars. If you are fortunate, you may outlast them.\n\nIf you are wise, you will learn from this folly. But know this: when the battle ends, the galaxy will be changed. Whether any of us are still here to see it is another matter entirely.\n\n... Hypothetically, if you were to attempt to save the galaxy, slaying the Behemoth may put an end to the Voidspawn's hunt.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2963`

## biocrisis.162.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.162.name&lang=en)

### 中文

横路之灾

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2450`

### English

In the way

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2965`

## biocrisis.162.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.162.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$已然降临我们的领域。这一远古实体据说无人能敌、不死不灭。它的眼中闪烁着玄秘的智慧，它的一举一动都牵动着纪元之重。\n\n我们的[species.GetEyeNamePlural]中只有在重压下破碎的信号。混沌、扭曲以及最深层次的宇宙之怖在脑海深处回荡。\n\n对我们来说，战胜这种野兽是不可想象的，但如果我们能帮助它杀死猎物，我们可能会阻止它的狂暴。找到§Y噬天巨兽§!并杀死它是我们生存的唯一机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2451`

### English

An $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$ has crossed into our territory. This ancient entity is rumored to be immortal and invincible. Its eyes shimmer with alien intellect, and its movements ripple with the weight of eons.\n\nOur [species.GetEyeNamePlural] are overwhelmed with fragmented signals. Chaos, distortion, and the deepest cosmic fear reverberate within us.\n\nFor us to prevail against such a beast is unthinkable, but we may yet halt its rampage if we can help it kill its prey. Finding the §YBehemoth§! and slaying it is our only shot at survival.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2966`

## biocrisis.162.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.162.a&lang=en)

### 中文

不惜一切代价躲避怪兽！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2452`

### English

Avoid the monster at all costs!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2967`

## biocrisis.175.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.175.name&lang=en)

### 中文

孳孽被杀

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2453`

### English

Spawn Killed

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2969`

## biocrisis.175.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.175.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空孳孽已不复存在。一个令星辰相形见绌的庞然大物已被消灭。它那不属于这个位面的形态的残骸如今在虚空中漂流，渐渐化为乌有。\n\n另一个帝国展示了我们难以想象的强大火力和协调能力。星海已不再是我们所认知的模样。力量的平衡已然改变，我们在其中的地位也随之动摇。\n\n这些巨兽的猎杀者究竟为何而战？这究竟是一次向所有可能反对他们的人传递信息的力量展示，还是某种更为可怕之事的前奏？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2454`

### English

The voidspawn is no more. An enormity that dwarfed the stars has been slain. The wreckage of its otherworldly form now drifts through the void, slowly dissipating into nothingness.\n\nAnother empire has demonstrated firepower and coordination beyond our wildest imagining. The galaxy is not as it seemed. The balance of power has shifted, as has our place within it.\n\nWhat drives them, these slayers of beasts? Was this a show of strength, a message to all who would oppose them, or merely the prelude to something far worse?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2970`

## biocrisis.175.desc.kaiju

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.175.desc.kaiju&lang=en)

### 中文

如果这个星系拥有能够摧毁$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$的力量，那么它同样也能摧毁我们。我们与被消灭的巨兽并无太大区别。\n\n那撕裂它古老躯体的火力，终有一日也可能转向我们。星系已经发生了变化，我们必须随之改变以求生存。\n\n我们的生存不能只倚仗盲目的热血了。虚空已经见证了一个顶级掠食者的陨落，也许下一个也只是时间问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2455`

### English

If this galaxy contains forces capable of destroying the $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$, then it can also destroy us. We are not so different from the beast that was slain.\n\nThe same firepower that sundered its ancient flesh could one day be turned against us. The galaxy has shifted, and we must change to meet it.\n\nOur survival will demand more than blind rage. The void has seen one apex predator fall. It may yet see another.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2971`

## biocrisis.175.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.175.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们应该小心行事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2456`

### English

We need to proceed carefully.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2972`

## biocrisis.180.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.180.name&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空猎手

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2457`

### English

Voidslayers

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2974`

## biocrisis.180.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.180.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最终，远古虚空孳孽的不灭神话终究还是在我们强大舰队的进攻下破灭了。解决了这个古老的威胁后，整个星系又一次沐浴在了自由的风中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2458`

### English

In the end, the rumored invincibility of the elder Voidspawn turned out to be yet another myth, dispelled by the might of our fleets. With this ancient threat now dealt with, the galaxy may again breathe easy.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2975`

## biocrisis.180.desc.kaiju

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.180.desc.kaiju&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$已逝，其血肉中还跳动着残余的力量。它古老而而强大，对我们来说就是一场滋养潜能的盛宴。\n\n孳孽的筋肉和骨髓将被吞食，它的独特本质将与我们的融合在一起。虚空孳孽的力量很巨大，而现在就是我们的了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2459`

### English

Though the $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$ has perished, its body thrums with residual energy. Ancient and potent, to us it is a nourishing banquet of raw potential.\n\nThe sinews and marrow of the beast shall be consumed, its alien essence entwined with our own. The Voidspawn's power was immense, and now, it is ours to wield.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2976`

## biocrisis.185.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.185.name&lang=en)

### 中文

天无二日

### English

There Can Be Only One

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2980`

## biocrisis.185.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.185.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在虚空的彼端，一个可怕的启示出现了：我们并非独自飞升。另一只噬天巨兽出现了，这只模仿者膨胀着怪诞的威严，妄图匹敌我们的完美。这是不能容忍的。\n\n一宇不容二兽。没有和平可言，只有血肉的盛宴。狩猎开始了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2463`

### English

Across the void, a dreadful revelation: we are not alone in our ascension. Another Behemoth has emerged, the imitator swollen in grotesque majesty, looking to emulate our perfection. This cannot stand.\n\nThere is no room for another apex predator. There is no peace to be made. Only flesh to be devoured. The hunt begins.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2981`

## biocrisis.185.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.185.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们要啃噬它的心脏！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2464`

### English

We shall feast on its heart!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2982`

## biocrisis.187.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.187.name&lang=en)

### 中文

四级噬天巨兽警告

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2465`

### English

Class IV Behemoth Warning

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2984`

## biocrisis.187.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.187.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空的深处有什么在搅动着。\n\n在繁星彼端，一个帝国开始了怪诞变异的最终阶段，孵育着一只可怖的噬天巨兽，它不仅仅是一件武器而是一个容器。他们不再寻求疆域统治，而是要凝聚为一。将意识和血肉融合，将帝国和恐惧同化。\n\n如果他们成功了，他们将不再是一群人，而是某种单一而巨大的饥饿化身。\n\n这是绝不可容忍的。如果想要阻止他们，那就只能是现在，赶在他们跨过最终阈值之前。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2466`

### English

Something stirs in the depths of the void.\n\nAcross the stars, an empire has begun the final stage of its grotesque transformation, breeding monstrous Behemoths, not as mere weapons, but as vessels. They do not seek dominion. They seek union. A merging of mind and flesh, of empire and horror.\n\nIf they succeed, they will cease to be a people and instead become a singular, vast hunger.\n\nThis cannot be allowed. If they are to be stopped, it must be done now, before the final threshold is crossed.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2985`

## biocrisis.187.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.187.a&lang=en)

猎杀巨兽！

### English

Hunt the beast!

## biocrisis.190.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.190.name&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空顶点

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2468`

### English

Apex Voidform

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2988`

## biocrisis.190.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.190.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最后的障碍已被扫除。伪装者，挑战者，低等生物的绝望挣扎全都陷入了沉默。群星本身也在颤抖，因为我们正站在真正蜕变的边缘。\n\n我们摆脱先祖们脆弱形体的束缚。行星是牢笼，帝国稍纵即逝。个体的幻觉很快就会融为庞然大物中巨大而完美的统一。思想和恐惧，智力和饥饿，合为一体。\n\n转移即将完成。当它完成时，我们将不复存在。\n\n但我们将永远存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2469`

### English

The last obstacles have been swept aside. The pretenders, the challengers, the desperate thrashing of lesser beings: all silenced. The stars themselves tremble, for we stand upon the precipice of true becoming.\n\nWe are no longer bound by the fragile forms of our ancestors. Planets are cages. Empires are fleeting. The illusion of individuality will soon dissolve into the vast, perfect unity of the Behemoth. Mind and horror, intellect and hunger, one.\n\nThe transference is almost over. When it is done, we shall no longer merely exist.\n\nWe shall thrive.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2989`

### English

## BEHEMOTH_TRANSFERENCE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_TRANSFERENCE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与巨兽之交已有时日。彻底的转变已唾手可得，只待我们的一声令下。我们所即之处将是飞升之巅，所弃之物莫过于星域凡尘。肉体、重力，于我将再无挂碍。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2475`

### English

We have communed with the Beast long enough. The transference is ready, awaiting only our command. We stand on the cusp of ascension, poised to abandon the pitiful ashes of our planetbound dominion and rise beyond the chains of flesh and gravity.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2996`

## biocrisis.191.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.191.name&lang=en)

### 中文

噬天巨兽胜利

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2476`

### English

Behemoth Victory

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2998`

## biocrisis.191.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.191.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

融合完成了！\n\n我们不再是过去的我们，也不再被低等生物的限制所束缚。我们是思想和饥饿的交织体，是跨越虚空的巨大意志。\n\n星系在我们脚下，脆弱而短暂。但我们也已超越了统治。我们自由了。可以流连于此，可以自由离开，可以自由狩猎。\n\n我们要以新获得的永生做些什么呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2477`

### English

The merging is complete!\n\nWe are no longer what we were, nor bound by the limits of lesser creatures. We are thought and hunger intertwined, a vast will stretching across the void.\n\nThe galaxy lies beneath us, fragile and fleeting. But we are beyond mere dominion. We are free. Free to linger. Free to depart. Free to hunt.\n\nWhat shall we do with our newfound eternity?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:2999`

## biocrisis.192.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.192.name&lang=en)

### 中文

无可阻挡的恐怖

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2483`

### English

The Unstoppable Horror

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3006`

## biocrisis.192.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.192.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

完成了。[behemoth_winner.GetName]超越了血肉，超越了帝国，也超越了一切能被称为文明的东西。它不再是个国家，它是力量的本身。\n\n星球在它面前吹弹可破，舰队化为齑粉。坚固的最终避难所像灰烬一样吹散到虚空。没有外交，没有抗辩，没有最后的立场。\n\n我们不是为了生存而战。我们只是在推迟灭亡。末日来了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2484`

### English

It is over. The [behemoth_winner.GetName] has ascended beyond flesh, beyond empire, beyond anything that could be called civilization. It is no longer a nation. It is a force.\n\nWorlds crumble before it. Fleets burn. The final refuges of the once-mighty scatter like embers in the void. There is no diplomacy, no plea, no final stand.\n\nWe are not fighting for survival. We are only delaying consumption. The end has come.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3007`

## biocrisis.192.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.192.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

[behemoth_winner.GetName]即将获得游戏胜利

### English

## biocrisis.196.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.196.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

数年前，噬天巨兽及其族群逃离了我们的星系。我们如释重负地看着这头本可能毁灭我们的野兽消失在无星的虚空之中。然后……无事发生。跨越了数十万光年之后，它就这么消失了。没有辐射，没有残影，没有引力涟漪。仿佛它从未存在过。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2487`

### English

Years ago, the Behemoth and its kin fled our galaxy. We watched on with relief as the beast that could have ended us vanished into starless void. And then... nothing. After crossing hundreds of thousands of lightyears, it simply disappeared. No radiation. No afterimage. No gravitational ripple. As if it had never existed at all.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3011`

## biocrisis.197.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.197.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

揭秘噬天巨兽的命运耗费了数年时间，而我们至今仍一无所知。由于没有超空间航道能够到达那里，我们只能依靠理论和近乎疯狂的科学来猜测它生命最后时刻发生了什么。\n\n这只生物毫无畏惧，一味地继续飞翔。然后，转瞬之间，它的身形扭曲，像扭曲的布料一样向内盘旋，最终消失了。没有挣扎，没有踪迹。\n\n各种理论层出不穷：是新的超光速方式？或是隐藏到了深空裂缝或异常现象中？或者更令人担忧的是，被某种外部力量吞噬，化为乌有？无论真相如何，它都远远超出了我们的认知范围……甚至可能超出了我们的理解范围。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2491`

### English

Uncovering the Behemoth's fate took years, and we're still in the dark. With no Hyperlanes reaching that far, we relied on theory and half-mad science to guess what happened in its final moments.\n\nThe creature showed no fear. It simply flew on. Then, in an instant, its form warped, spiraling inward like twisted fabric, and vanished. No struggle. No trace.\n\nTheories abound: a new form of FTL? Hidden by a deep-space rift or an anomaly? Or more concerning, folded into inexistence by an exterior power? Whatever the truth, it lies far beyond our reach... and possibly our comprehension.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3016`

## biocrisis.520.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.520.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

噬天巨兽死了。\n\n它硕大无朋的躯体静静地飘在虚空中，有如一座纪念碑，诉说着我们的胜利，也记录着理解的边际。[Root.GetScientistPluralCapital]争先恐后地分析它的残骸，渴望从它那不可思议的心灵中攫取秘密。然而，每一次复活的尝试——无论是机器、死灵术，或是最绝望的祈祷——都失败了。\n\n原因现在已经非常清楚了：巨兽的大脑不仅仅是一个细胞网络，而是一个有机超导体晶格，以任何已知智能——人工智能、生物智能或奥术智能——都无法复制的方式交织在一起。它死后，神经结构如同破损得无法修复的电路一样崩溃。没有能量，没有意志，没有力量可以重新组装这种逝去之物。\n\n星系中最具力量的意识现在、永远陷入了沉默。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2498`

### English

The Behemoth is dead.\n\nIts titanic form drifts lifelessly in the void, a monument to both our triumph and the limits of comprehension. [Root.GetScientistPluralCapital] scrambled to analyze its remains, eager to plunder the secrets of its impossible mind. Yet every attempt to revive it - by machine, necromancy, or even the most desperate invocations failed.\n\nThe reason has now become painfully clear: The Behemoth's brain was not merely a network of cells but a lattice of organic superconductors, interwoven in ways no known intelligence - artificial, biological, or arcane - can replicate. In death, its neural structure collapsed like a circuit shattered beyond repair. No energy, no will, no force can reassemble what has been lost.\n\nThe greatest mind in the galaxy is now, and forever, silent.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3025`

## BEHEMOTH_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

从理论上讲，我们最近在噬天巨兽遗传学方面的突破可以扩展到进一步变异我们的创造物上。尽管遗传的稳定性仍是一个问题，但只要有时间和资源，我们有信心能创造出进一步的生物强化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2502`

### English

Our recent breakthroughs in behemoth genetics could theoretically be expanded to further mutate our creations. Genetic stability is a concern, but with time and resources we are confident that we can bring about further biological enhancements.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3030`

## BEHEMOTH_FATE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABEHEMOTH_FATE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

噬天巨兽离开我们的星系后，便飘入虚空，最终消失得无影无踪。我们可以尝试解开这个谜团，但距离如此遥远，只能采用非常规方法。答案或许如同虚空本身一样模糊不清。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2504`

### English

After leaving our galaxy, the Behemoth drifted into the void, then vanished. We can try to unravel the mystery, but at this distance, only unconventional methods remain. The answers are likely as hazy as the void itself.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3033`

## biocrisis.280.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.280.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经开发了几种诱变配方来增强我们的噬天巨兽，每一种都是量身定制的，可以解锁新的力量和适应性。然而，它庞杂的生理机能只能承受一次注射——任何结合多种配方的尝试都会导致灾难性的细胞衰竭。进化和毁灭之间的界限很薄，我们必须明智地选择强化的方式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2543`

### English

We have developed several mutagenic formulas designed to enhance our Behemoths, each tailored to unlock new strengths and adaptations. However, their immense physiology can only withstand a single injection - any attempt to combine multiple formulas results in catastrophic cellular failure. The line between evolution and annihilation is razor-thin, and we must choose our enhancements wisely.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3076`

## crisobj_build_bioships_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_build_bioships_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在掌握了生物舰船的培育技术后，我们进一步优化并扩展了这些流程。这种持续的共生关系带来了日益显著的优势，增强了我们的舰队实力，并巩固了我们对生命宇宙的统治。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2557`

### English

Having mastered the cultivation of biological ships, we now refine and expand these processes. This ongoing symbiosis yields ever-greater perks, enhancing our fleets and bolstering our dominion over the living cosmos.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3092`

### 中文

敌对的太空兽群威胁我们的主导一切生命的大业。我们必须果断行动，消灭它们以消除其对我们的霸权构成的威胁。

Hostile Space Fauna threatens our biological dominance. We must act decisively, destroying them to neutralize their threat to our supremacy.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3098`

## crisobj_cap_fauna_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_cap_fauna_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

未驯化的太空兽群是一种失控元素，构成独特的挑战。我们必须果断行动，捕获这些生命体，以利用它们的潜力，确保我们的主导地位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2565`

### English

Untamed Space Fauna act as rogue elements, posing a unique challenge. We must act decisively, capturing these entities to exploit their potential in order to ensure our supremacy.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3100`

## crisobj_build_behemoth_egg_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_build_behemoth_egg_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

培育超大的兽卵是我们超越行星生活琐事的关键一步。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2567`

### English

Growing supersized zygotes is a crucial step in our elevation beyond the trivialities of planet-based life.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3102`

## crisobj_birth_behemoth_name

### English

Birth Behemoths

## crisobj_birth_behemoth_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_birth_behemoth_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在浩瀚的宇宙中，一种庞大的生命体正在我们谨慎的引导下逐渐成形。这些噬天巨兽，源于我们的雄心与掌控力，将成为重塑力量平衡的巨擘，使局势朝着有利于我们的方向转变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2569`

### English

In the vastness of space, colossal lifeforms are taking shape under our watchful guidance. These behemoths, born of our ambition and mastery, will emerge as titanic forces, reshaping the balance of power in our favor.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3104`

## crisobj_behemoth_rage_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_behemoth_rage_name&lang=en)

### 中文

噬天巨兽暴怒

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2570`

### English

Behemoth Raging

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3105`

## crisobj_behemoth_rage_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_behemoth_rage_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的噬天巨兽被释放于星辰之间，以原始的狂怒肆虐，所过之处皆成废墟。它们那不受控制的愤怒是我们力量的明证，如同自然之力，仅在我们选择施加意志时，才听从我们的号令。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2571`

### English

Unleashed upon the stars, our Behemoths rampage with primal fury, leaving devastation in their wake. Their uncontrolled wrath is a testament to our power, a force of nature that answers only to our will, when we choose to exert it.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3106`

### English

## biocrisis.210.desc.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.210.desc.base&lang=en)

### 中文

某种东西在涌动。我们内心的饥饿并非盲目的原生欲望，而是具有某种适应性。新的事物悄然出现，充满潜力的脉动。\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2573`

### English

Something stirs. The hunger within us is not mindless, but adaptive. New growths slither into existence, pulsing with potential.\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3109`

## biocrisis.210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们的卵是我们血脉延续的根本。我们必须不惜一切代价保护并照料它们。让我们引导进化，以造福未来的幼年体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2574`

### English

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$Our eggs are the literal lifeblood of our lineage. They must be protected and cared for at all costs. Let us guide our evolution to benefit our future hatchlings.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3110`

## biocrisis.215.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.215.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$在恒星风浪中游弋并穿越虚空，是仅有少数太空物种才所掌握的技能。我们的战术优势在于我们的愤怒与力量，但如果我们的机动性能够提升，又会有怎样一番天地呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2581`

### English

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$Swimming the solar waves and traversing the void is a skill possessed by few spacefaring species. Our tactical strengths lie in our fury and our might, but what if our mobility could be improved?

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3118`

## biocrisis.230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$在激烈的战斗中，每一秒都至关重要。我们所造成的伤害是一种死亡仪式，是敌人在他们渺小的生命消逝之前所经历的最后时刻。

## biocrisis.240.desc

### 中文

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们的后代将如潮水般涌出，我们将肆虐行星，掠夺恒星系中一切可食之物，而大多数存在皆属此类。我们必须自问，如何才能最好地支持我们的后代？

## biocrisis.250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abiocrisis.250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们可以释放毁灭性的低温碎屑波和高温碎屑波的，其威力足以将现实撕作碎片。简而言之，我们培育了一种能撕裂星系的基本构成的武器。\n\n但我们的通知不会至于毁灭。我们感受得到巨兽的每根肌腱，每一次脉搏，每一块巨大的肌肉都屈从于我们的意志，就像是我们自己的肉体一样。我们只需动动脑子，就能指挥它那庞大的身躯：它的四肢，它的巨口，它那巨大的宇生之心随我们的意图而跳动。这不仅仅是一个容器；我即是巨兽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2633`

### English

$biocrisis.210.desc.base$We can now unleash a catastrophic wave of cryoclastic and pyroclastic fury, powerful enough to tear reality asunder. In short, we wield a weapon that will scorch the galaxy itself.\n\nBut our dominion does not end with destruction. We feel the Behemoth's every sinew, its every pulse, each titanic muscle bending to our will as if it were our own flesh. With a mere thought, we command its vast form: its limbs, its maw, the titanic void-born heart that beats with our intent. This is no mere vessel; we are the Behemoth now.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3177`

## concept_growth_factor_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aconcept_growth_factor_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

生长因数用于衡量你的噬天巨兽吸收的营养物质数量，并影响局势的进展速度。\n\n每月减少§R0.75%§!\n\n$behemoth_finale_situation_monthly_change_tooltip$\n\n每$pop_group_unit$£pop£§H被转化人口§!的最小值等于§G0.5%§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2707`

### English

Growth Factor is a measure of the quantity of nutrients absorbed by your Behemoth, and affects how fast the situation will progress.\n\nEvery month, it decreases by §R0.75%§!\n\n$behemoth_finale_situation_monthly_change_tooltip$\n\nThe Minimum Value is equal to §G0.5%§! per $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HTransferred Pops§!.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3258`

## behemoth_finale_situation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abehemoth_finale_situation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们需要一些时间来适应如此庞大的形态。在融入这个身体的过程中，我们必须时刻保持对周围环境的警觉。如今，我们与虚空之间已无任何阻隔。\n\n我们当前的['concept_growth_factor']为：§G[growth_factor_value]%§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2708`

### English

It will take some time for us to adjust to a form so massive in scale. As we grow into this body, we must remain aware of our surroundings. There now stands nothing between us and the void.\n\nOur current ['concept_growth_factor'] is: §G[growth_factor_value]%§!

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3259`

## SHIP_BEHEMOTH_RAGE_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_BEHEMOTH_RAGE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

噬天巨兽是任性的、桀骜不驯的，不会忍受长久的控制。迟早，他们内心的愤怒就会点燃，化为一场无法克制的宇宙风暴。也许智慧不在于等待，而在于我们自己划燃烧火柴。要让我们选择释放风暴，而不是让风暴降临到我们头上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2895`

### English

Behemoths are willful, untamed titans, and they do not suffer control for long. Sooner or later, the fury within will ignite, a cosmic tempest beyond restraint. Perhaps wisdom lies not in waiting, but in striking the match ourselves, unleashing the storm when we choose, rather than when it chooses us.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3476`

## behemoth_rage_ship_button

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abehemoth_rage_ship_button&lang=en)

### 中文

§H激怒§!\n\n释放§Y噬天巨兽§!。\n狂暴的噬天巨兽将冲向最近的§Y殖民地§!或§Y噬天巨兽卵§!并试图摧毁它。\n狂暴状态通常持续§Y180天§!，但多种因素可能影响其持续时间。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—在§R战斗§!或§R轰炸§!中，巨兽不会平静下来。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—如果我们在战斗中§G击败§!狂暴的噬天巨兽，它将重新回到我们的控制之下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2896`

### English

§HEnrage§!\n\nLet loose the §YBehemoth§!.\nThe raging Behemoth will head towards the closest §YColony§! or §YBehemoth Egg§! and attempt to destroy it.\nRage normally lasts §Y180 days§!, but several factors can affect that duration.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- While in §RCombat§! or §RBombarding§!, a Behemoth will not calm down.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- If we §GDefeat§! a raging Behemoth in combat, it will return under our control.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3477`

## SHIP_BEHEMOTH_COCOON_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_BEHEMOTH_COCOON_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y噬天巨兽§!能够在气态巨行星的湍流层中锚定自身，从其富含重元素和复杂分子化合物的稠密大气中汲取养分。随着时间的推移，这些营养物质促进了它们的生长，并进一步增强了它们本已巨大的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2905`

### English

§YBehemoths§! can anchor themselves within the turbulent layers of a gas giant, drawing sustenance from its dense atmospheres rich in heavy elements and complex molecular compounds. Over time, this nourishment fuels their growth and fortifies their immense strength.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3489`

## elder_voidspawn_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aelder_voidspawn_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有一只巨大的虚空孳孽正在星系中横冲直撞。它想要猎杀巨型生物，如果我们替它解决了这些目标，它可能就会放过我们。\n\n目标：寻找并消灭星系中所有四级噬天巨兽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2928`

### English

There's a big voidspawn plowing through the galaxy. It wants to kill big behemoths and presumably, if we kill them for it, it might leave us alone.\n\nOBJECTIVE: Find and Kill all tier 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3515`

## behemoth_victory_chain_title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abehemoth_victory_chain_title&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2929`

### English

King of the Monsters

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3517`

## behemoth_victory_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abehemoth_victory_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着心智融合的完成，我们的雄心已经近在咫尺了。我们必须适应新的共同身体，并不断转移人民的心智，但更重要的是，我们需要粉碎任何可能的竞争者，无论他们是谁。\n\n§H目标§!：\n—寻找并击杀星系中其他所有的4级噬天巨兽。\n—完成生长痛局势\n—击杀远古虚空孳孽

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2930`

### English

With the Mind Meld complete, only a few more steps lie between us and our ambitions. We must grow accustomed to our new shared body and keep transferring the minds of our people, but more importantly we'll need to crush any would be contender, whomever they may be.\n\n§HOBJECTIVES§!:\n- Find and Kill any other class 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.\n- Complete the Growing Pains situation.\n- Slay the Elder Voidspawn.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3518`

## behemoth_transference_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abehemoth_transference_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如今，野兽与我们人群之间存续的联系为栖居与行星之上的文明投射了新的曙光。与融入野兽相比，这种生存显得徒劳无益。如今，每个人都渴望与野兽合为一体，并感到……无比饥渴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/biogenesis_l_simp_chinese.yml:2932`

### English

The link that now exists between the Beast and our population casts a new light over planetbound existence. One of futility compared to becoming one with the beast. Everyone now craves unity in the Beast, and is feeling... ravenous.

Source: `localisation/english/biogenesis_l_english.yml:3521`
